title.en: The UN has backed a new world map that makes Africa bigger and the US smaller
title.zh: 联合国支持新世界地图，非洲更大，美国更小

summary.en: The United Nations General Assembly has voted to support a new world map, known as the Equal Earth cartographic projection, which aims for a more accurate representation of continental landmasses by making Africa larger and North America and Europe smaller. The resolution was backed by 164 countries, with the United...
summary.zh: 联合国大会投票支持一张新的世界地图，即“地球相等”地图投影，该地图旨在通过使非洲大陆更大、北美和欧洲更小来更准确地表示大陆陆地面积。该决议得到了164个国家的支持，而美国投票反对，另外六个国家弃权。

body.en:
The United Nations General Assembly voted Saturday to back a resolution spearheaded by several African countries to adopt a map that makes their continent bigger while shrinking North America and Europe.

Aimed at "a more accurate representation" of continental landmasses, the resolution was supported by 164 countries while the United States voted against it and six other states abstained.

The new map — known as the Equal Earth cartographic projection — "is a relevant option for improving the accuracy of the cartographic representation of the world," the resolution said.

It urges member states to adopt the new map in place of the traditional Mercator projection, which was designed for maritime navigation by Flemish cartographer Gerardus Mercator in 1569.

Foreign Minister Robert Dussey of Togo, which drove the resolution, said maps "guide education, nourish the imagination, and influence collective perceptions."

"They are therefore never neutral, when they present a distorted image of our planet, they risk perpetuating inaccurate representation that are passed down through generation."

The United States, however, slammed the resolution, saying such moves are "the reason this institution is losing its credibility."

"Instead of focusing on genuine problems ... this body is debating map projects from the 16th century and their role in promoting reparations and cognitive justice," US representative Yaryna Ferencevych said ahead of the vote.

The Mercator projection focused on accurate depictions of the shapes and angles of land masses, but their relative sizes were often inaccurate — in part due to the challenge of rendering a three-dimensional globe onto a two-dimensional map.

It inflated northern regions and compressed equatorial ones, making Europe and North America appear much larger, while shrinking Africa and South America.

A group of cartographers launched the Equal Earth projection in 2018. It makes Africa, Latin America, South Asia and Oceania appear much larger.

"Equal Earth preserves the relative surface areas of continents and, as much as possible, shows their shapes as they appear on a globe," one of the cartographers, Bojan Savric, told the Agence France-Presse (AFP) news agency in 2025.

France — which co-sponsored the resolution in support of the new map — announced Saturday that it would abandon the Mercator projection.

In that map, "the United States, Russia and China take on a disproportionate visual prominence compared to Africa, Latin America or southeast Asia," while "Greenland appears almost as big as Africa," Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot...
body.zh: 联合国大会周六投票支持由几个非洲国家牵头的一项决议，通过一张地图，使非洲大陆变得更大，同时缩小北美和欧洲。 该决议旨在“更准确地描述”大陆陆地，得到了 164 个国家的支持，美国投了反对票，其他 6 个国家投了弃权票。 该决议称，这张新地图被称为“平等地球制图投影”，“是提高世界地图表示准确性的一个相关选择”。 它敦促成员国采用新地图来代替传统的墨卡托投影，该投影是由佛兰德斯制图师杰拉杜斯·墨卡托于 1569 年为海上导航而设计的。 推动该决议的多哥外交部长罗伯特·杜西表示，地图“指导教育、滋养想象力、影响集体观念”。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “因此，他们从来都不是中立的，当他们呈现出我们星球的扭曲形象时，他们就有可能将不准确的表述永久化，并代代相传。” 然而，美国猛烈抨击了该决议，称此类举动是“这个机构失去信誉的原因”。 美国代表亚里娜·费伦斯维奇 (Yaryna Ferencevych) 在投票前表示：“该机构没有关注真正的问题……而是在讨论 16 世纪的地图项目及其在促进赔偿和认知正义方面的作用。” 墨卡托投影专注于准确描绘陆地块的形状和角度，但它们的相对大小通常不准确——部分原因是在二维地图上渲染三维地球仪的挑战。 它使北部地区膨胀，赤道地区压缩，使欧洲和北美显得更大，同时缩小了非洲和南美洲。 一群制图师于 2018 年推出了平等地球投影。它使非洲、拉丁美洲、南亚和大洋洲显得更大。 “《平等地球》保留了大陆的相对表面积，并尽可能地显示它们在地球仪上的形状，”制图师之一博扬·萨夫里克 (Bojan Savric) 在 2025 年告诉法新社 (AFP)。 法国是支持新地图的决议的共同提案国，周六宣布将放弃墨卡托投影。 在该地图中，“与非洲、拉丁美洲或东南亚相比，美国、俄罗斯和中国在视觉上显得格外突出”，而“格陵兰岛看起来几乎和非洲一样大”，外交部长让-诺埃尔·巴罗……

reflection.en: The UN's decision to adopt a new world map, emphasizing a more accurate representation of landmasses, has sparked international debate, with 164 nations in favor and the United States opposed. This situation underscores the ongoing challenge of achieving global consensus and the importance of seeking peaceful dialogue even when perspectives differ...
reflection.zh: 联合国决定采用一张新的世界地图，强调更准确地表示陆地面积，这引发了国际辩论，164个国家表示支持，而美国则表示反对。这种情况凸显了在存在显著分歧时，实现全球共识的持续挑战以及寻求和平对话的重要性。

title.en: Trump threatens to halt trade with some countries unless the Federal Reserve lowers interest rates – US politics live
title.zh: 特朗普威胁除非美联储降息否则将停止与某些国家的贸易——美国政治直播

title.en: Trump says Iran war is 'small potatoes' as conflict grinds on
title.zh: 特朗普称伊朗战争是“小事一桩”，冲突仍在继续

summary.en: As the contentious midterm elections approach, the Trump administration is attempting to reframe the unpopular Iran war.
summary.zh: 随着充满争议的中期选举临近，特朗普政府正试图重新定义不受欢迎的伊朗战争。

body.en:
President Donald Trump said Saturday that the Iran war was "small potatoes" for the United States, in his administration's latest bid to play down the conflict ahead of crucial midterm elections.

Trump's comments came a day after Vice President JD Vance said that "I wouldn't call it a war" despite an upsurge in clashes between Iran and the United States over the Strait of Hormuz.

"A lot of people don't call it a war. I call it a military conflict because it's small potatoes for us," Trump told reporters in the Oval Office when asked about Vance's remarks.

"It's not a big thing. We did Venezuela, and we did this," added Trump, who was surrounded by cattle ranchers invited for the signing of two executive orders on beef processing.

The six-month-old war in which 18 US troops and thousands of Iranians have died has reached a stalemate, with Iran disrupting shipping traffic in the strategic waterway.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

On 28 February, the day the US and Israel first attacked Iran, Trump described the war as "massive and ongoing."

But with fuel prices threatening to cost Trump's Republicans their control of Congress in November's midterms, his administration has been trying to minimize the conflict.

Trump said the US was carrying out "intermittent strikes" but that "we're not fighting right now."

He reiterated his claims that the United States effectively controlled the Strait of Hormuz and had decimated Iran's military.

"What we've done is amazing. We took over Venezuela, and we have essentially taken over Iran," Trump said.

Pressed on calling the war "small potatoes" when 18 service members died, an increasingly irate Trump compared the Iran war to the years-long US wars in Vietnam and Afghanistan.

"I don't think it matters what you call it. What matters is the fact we have had tremendous success. We've stopped Iran from having a nuclear weapon," he said.

body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统周六表示，伊朗战争对美国来说是“小人物”，这是他的政府在关键的中期选举之前淡化这场冲突的最新举措。 特朗普发表此番言论的前一天，副总统万斯表示，尽管伊朗和美国之间因霍尔木兹海峡发生的冲突激增，“我不会称其为战争”。 当被问及万斯的言论时，特朗普在椭圆形办公室对记者说：“很多人不称其为战争。我称其为军事冲突，因为这对我们来说是小菜一碟。” “这不是什么大事。我们做到了委内瑞拉，我们做到了这一点，”特朗普补充道。他周围都是受邀签署两项牛肉加工行政命令的牧场主。 这场持续六个月的战争已造成 18 名美军和数千名伊朗人死亡，目前已陷入僵局，伊朗扰乱了战略水道的航运交通。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 2 月 28 日，即美国和以色列首次袭击伊朗的那一天，特朗普将这场战争描述为“大规模且持续的”。 但由于燃油价格有可能让特朗普领导的共和党在 11 月中期选举中丧失对国会的控制权，他的政府一直在努力将冲突最小化。 特朗普表示，美国正在进行“间歇性打击”，但“我们现在没有战斗”。 他重申了他的说法，即美国有效控制了霍尔木兹海峡并摧毁了伊朗的军队。 “我们所做的事情令人惊叹。我们接管了委内瑞拉，我们基本上已经接管了伊朗，”特朗普说。 当 18 名军人死亡时，特朗普被追问称这场战争是“小人物”，他越来越愤怒，将伊朗战争与美国在越南和阿富汗进行的长达数年的战争进行了比较。 “我认为你怎么称呼它并不重要。重要的是我们已经取得了巨大成功。我们已经阻止了伊朗拥有核武器，”他说。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: When political leaders describe a conflict as 'small potatoes,' it can obscure the human cost and the ongoing reality for those involved. The pursuit of peace requires acknowledging the gravity of every situation, not just its political expediency. May we pray for wisdom and a genuine desire for peace in all international relations.
reflection.zh: 当政治领导人将冲突描述为“小事一桩”时，这可能会掩盖其人力成本以及对卷入其中的人的持续影响。追求和平需要认识到每种情况的严重性，而不仅仅是其政治上的便利性。愿我们为所有国际关系中的智慧和对和平的真诚渴望而祈祷。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Democrats demand that DHS comply with inquiry into death of Rohingya refugee abandoned by border agents
title.zh: 民主党人要求国土安全部就罗兴亚难民死亡事件配合调查

summary.en: Democratic lawmakers are demanding that the Department of Homeland Security release records and cooperate with an investigation into the death of Nurul Amin Shah Alam, a nearly blind Rohingya refugee who died after being left outside a closed coffee shop on a freezing night in Buffalo earlier this year.
summary.zh: 民主党议员要求国土安全部公布记录，并配合对努鲁尔·阿明·沙阿·阿拉姆的死亡调查。他是一名近乎失明的罗兴亚难民，今年早些时候在布法罗一个寒冷的夜晚被遗弃在一家关门的咖啡店外后死亡。

body.en: Lawmakers say agency hasn’t released ‘meaningful’ records concerning death of nearly blind refugee in Buffalo Democratic lawmakers are demanding that the Department of Homeland Security turn over records and fully cooperate with an investigation into the death of Nurul Amin Shah Alam, a nearly blind Rohingya refugee who died after US border agents left him outside a closed coffee shop on a freezing night in Buffalo earlier this year. At a press conference in Buffalo on Friday, standing just a few feet away from where Shah was found dead, Tim Kennedy of New York was joined by Bennie Thompson of Mississippi, the ranking Democrat on the House homeland security committee, Lou Correa of California, and Nellie Pou of New Jersey in calling on DHS to cooperate with the Erie county district attorney’s investigation. reflection.en: The tragic death of Nurul Amin Shah Alam, a nearly blind Rohingya refugee left to freeze outside a closed coffee shop, calls to mind the responsibility to speak for those who have no voice. Scripture urges us to defend the rights of the poor and needy, ensuring that vulnerable individuals are not overlooked or abandoned by systems meant to protect them.
reflection.zh: 近乎失明的罗兴亚难民努鲁尔·阿明·沙阿·阿拉姆被遗弃在一家关门的咖啡店外冻死，这一悲惨事件提醒我们有责任为那些无法发声的人代言。经文敦促我们要维护贫穷和有需要者的权利，确保弱势群体不被本应保护他们的体制所忽视或抛弃。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Judge declares mistrial in Lindsay Clancy murder case after jury fails to reach unanimous verdict – as it happened
title.zh: 法官就林赛·克兰西谋杀案宣布无效审判，陪审团未能达成一致裁决——实时更新

summary.en: A judge has declared a mistrial in the case of Lindsay Clancy, a Massachusetts mother accused of killing her three children, after the jury remained deadlocked for over 38 hours of deliberations. The defense had sought intervention from a higher court, delaying the proceedings.
summary.zh: 马萨诸塞州一名母亲林赛·克兰西被控杀害她的三个孩子，陪审团经过38个多小时的审议仍未能达成一致裁决，法官因此宣布审判无效。辩方曾寻求更高法院的干预，导致程序延误。

body.en: This blog is now closed. You can find more of our reporting on the mistrial of Massachusetts mother who killed her three children here: Full report: Judge declares mistrial in Lindsay Clancy case Explained: Lindsay Clancy mistrial – what happens next? Five key moments from ‘America’s saddest murder trial’ If you’re just joining us, the judge in the trial of Lindsay Clancy , the Massachusetts mother accused of killing her three young children, plans to declare a mistrial after the jury could not reach a unanimous verdict and remained deadlocked after a week of deliberations . Jurors in Plymouth state court spent more than 38 hours in deliberations over the charges against the 36-year-old mom, which came on the heels of a weeks-long trial that directed national attention to maternal mental health issues that can occur postpartum. Closing arguments ended last Thursday in the trial of Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts mother who admitted killing her three young children – Cora, 5, Dawson, 3, and Callan, 8 months – in January 2023. Her attempt to kill herself after killing the children left her with spinal injuries that paralyzed her from the waist down. Clancy pleaded not guilty to three counts of first-degree murder due to lack of criminal responsibility, also known as an insanity defense. She faced life in prison if convicted. The tragic case has sparked a national conversation about the state of postpartum mental healthcare in the United States. The charges up for consideration were first-degree murder, which involves “deliberate premeditation” or “extreme atrocity or cruelty” and is punishable by life in prison without the possibility of parole, or second-degree murder, without either of those conditions, punishable by life in prison with the possibility of parole. They also considered lesser manslaughter charges, which is punishable by up to 20 years in prison. If they had found Clancy not guilty, she could have spent the rest of her life in hospital, with the eventual possibility of release at a later time if the court determined she was not a danger to others. Jurors began deliberating last Thursday on whether to accept her insanity defense, but, almost 40 hours on, they have now declared three times that they could not reach a unanimous decision. A jury note indicated that jurors were split 11-1 toward an acquittal but a holdout juror “has acknowledged doubt but refuses to apply it to the verdict”. The prosecution argued this indicated a disagreement among jurors over how to weigh the evidence, while the defense argued the juror had “lied” when they swore to the judge to properly follow the law. body.zh: 由于辩方寻求高等法院干预，法官在拖延后宣布审判无效 陪审团第三次陷入僵局后，法官将宣布林赛·克兰西案审判无效如果你刚刚加入我们，马萨诸塞州母亲林赛·克兰西被控杀害其三个年幼孩子的审判中的法官，计划在陪审团无法达成一致裁决并经过一周的审议后陷入僵局后宣布审判无效。普利茅斯州法院的陪审员们花了超过 38 个小时的时间审议对这位 36 岁母亲的指控，此前经过为期一周的审判，该审判引起了全国对产后可能发生的母亲心理健康问题的关注。马萨诸塞州母亲林赛·克兰西 (Lindsay Clancy) 的审判于上周四结束，她承认在 2023 年 1 月杀害了自己的三个孩子——5 岁的科拉 (Cora)、3 岁的道森 (Dawson) 和 8 个月大的卡兰 (Callan)。她在杀死孩子后试图自杀，导致脊椎受伤，导致腰部以下瘫痪。由于缺乏刑事责任，克兰西对三项一级谋杀罪不认罪，也称为精神错乱辩护。如果罪名成立，她将面临终身监禁。这起悲惨案件引发了关于美国产后心理保健状况的全国性讨论。供考虑的指控是一级谋杀，涉及“故意预谋”或“极端暴行或残忍”，可判处终身监禁，不得假释；二级谋杀，如果没有上述任何一个条件，可判处终身监禁，并可假释。他们还考虑了较轻的过失杀人罪，最高可判处 20 年监禁。如果他们判定克兰西无罪，她可能会在医院度过余生，如果法院确定她不会对他人构成危险，最终有可能出院。陪审员于上周四开始审议是否接受她的精神错乱辩护，但近 40 小时过去了，他们现已三度宣布无法达成一致决定。陪审团记录显示，陪审员们以 11 比 1 的比例支持无罪释放，但坚持不懈的陪审员“承认存在疑问，但拒绝将其应用于判决”。检方辩称，这表明陪审员之间在如何权衡证据方面存在分歧，而辩方则辩称，陪审员在向法官发誓要正确遵守法律时“撒了谎”。但法官最终拒绝进一步询问陪审员或将他们驱逐出境。在陪审团今天“怀着沉重的心情”宣布仍然无法“也将无法”做出裁决后，法官表示他打算宣布审判无效。现在已经被扔进...

reflection.en: The legal system aims for justice, but sometimes the process itself falters. When a jury cannot reach a unanimous verdict, as in the case of Lindsay Clancy, it underscores the profound difficulty in discerning truth and achieving resolution. This situation echoes the ancient cry of Habakkuk, lamenting a justice system that seemed to fail, leaving the...
reflection.zh: 法律体系旨在实现正义，但有时程序本身会陷入困境。当陪审团无法达成一致裁决时，正如林赛·克兰西的案件所示，这凸显了辨别真相和达成解决的深层困难。这种情况呼应了哈巴谷古老的哀叹，他哀叹一个似乎失灵的司法系统，让无辜者遭受痛苦。

verse.textEn: The law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
verse.textZh: 因此律法放松，公理也不显明；恶人围困义人，所以公理显然颠倒。

title.en: Trump’s ‘retribution’ could now include Falklands as favor to Milei – and revenge on the UK
title.zh: 特朗普的“报复”可能包括将福克兰群岛作为送给米莱的礼物——并报复英国

summary.en: US president suggests he might support his Argentinian acolyte’s drive to reclaim sovereignty of disputed islands. Donald Trump has long embraced vengeance. “I am your retribution,” he declared to an admiring audience at the 2023 Conservative Political Action Conference (CPAC) as he commenced his march back to the...
summary.zh: 美国总统暗示他可能会支持他阿根廷的追随者收回争议岛屿主权的要求。唐纳德·特朗普长期以来一直拥抱复仇。“我是你们的报复，”他在 2023 年保守派政治行动会议 (CPAC) 上向一群崇拜者宣称，当时他正开始重返白宫的征程。

body.en: US president suggests he might support his Argentinian acolyte’s drive to reclaim sovereignty of disputed islands Donald Trump has long embraced vengeance. “I am your retribution,” he declared to an admiring audience at the 2023 Conservative Political Action Conference (CPAC) as he commenced his march back to the White House. It is unlikely Argentina, and far-flung holdovers of the former British empire, were on the US president’s mind at the time. Continue reading...
body.zh: 美国总统暗示他可能会支持他的阿根廷助手收回争议岛屿主权的努力唐纳德·特朗普长期以来一直热衷于复仇。 “我是你们的报应，”他在 2023 年保守党政治行动会议 (CPAC) 上开始返回白宫时向钦佩的观众宣布。当时美国总统不太可能考虑阿根廷和前大英帝国的遥远保留地。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The former US president's rhetoric of "retribution" and offering support for territorial claims as a political favor highlights a dangerous cycle of vengeance. The call to "overcome evil with good" (Romans 12:21) challenges us to break free from retaliatory impulses, seeking instead paths of reconciliation and justice that do not perpetuate conflict.
reflection.zh: 美国前总统的“报复”言论，以及将支持领土主张作为政治恩惠的提议，凸显了一个危险的报复循环。《罗马书》12:21 呼吁“以善胜恶”，挑战我们摆脱报复的冲动，转而寻求不延续冲突的和解与公正之路。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Trump's peace envoys to visit Moscow and Kyiv over weekend
title.zh: 特朗普的和平使者周末将访问莫斯科和基辅，据报道

summary.en: Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner have led President Donald Trump's efforts to end the Russia-Ukraine war - but talks have stalled.
summary.zh: 史蒂夫·维特科夫和贾里德·库什纳领导了特朗普总统结束俄乌战争的努力——但会谈陷入僵局。

body.en:
US negotiators Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner will visit Russia and Ukraine this weekend, as efforts to end the war appear to be gathering pace.

Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky confirmed he will meet with the envoys on Sunday, after they visit Moscow on Saturday to hold talks with meet Russian President Vladimir Putin.

Witkoff and Kushner have led US President Donald Trump's efforts to broker a peace deal, but a gulf remains between the two warring sides.

"They are bringing with them a proposal to end the war," Trump told reporters when asked about the visits.

Earlier on Friday, Zelensky said a Russian drone hit the office of Ukraine's security chief Oleksandr Poklad in Kyiv. Poklad appears to be unharmed.

In a post on social media, Zelensky said he had ordered Poklad, who head the SBU security service, to respond "adequately" to the attack.

Witkoff and Kushner, Trump's son-in-law, have visited Russia multiple times, but the purported talks will be the first in Ukraine.

Zelensky said he would guarantee the safety of Russian airspace during the envoys' visit and called for Russia to do the same for Ukraine.

Russia's state news agency Tass said Witkoff and Kushner were "expected to arrive in Moscow and then to Kyiv... on 5-6 September", quoting a source.

Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov later told reporters: "I wouldn't announce anything, but when these contacts take place, we will inform you."

Meanwhile, Putin told an international economic forum on Thursday that "there are chances" a peace deal could be reached.

But he showed no sign of backing down from his maximalist demands, which included more territorial concessions from Ukraine.

Kyiv and its European allies have repeatedly rejected Putin's terms saying they are tantamount to capitulation.

Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, and currently controls about 20% of its territory.
body.zh: 据报道，美国谈判代表史蒂夫·威特科夫和贾里德·库什纳将于本周末访问俄罗斯和乌克兰，结束战争的努力似乎正在加快步伐。 Axios 援引美国官员的话说，特使们将于周六在莫斯科会见俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京，然后周日在基辅与乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基举行会谈。 威特科夫和库什纳领导了美国总统唐纳德·特朗普促成和平协议的努力，但交战双方之间仍然存在鸿沟。 周五早些时候，泽连斯基表示，一架俄罗斯无人机袭击了乌克兰安全部长亚历山大·波克拉德位于基辅的办公室。波克拉德似乎没有受伤。 泽连斯基在社交媒体上发帖称，他已命令 SBU 安全部门负责人波克拉德对此次袭击做出“充分”反应。 威特科夫和特朗普的女婿库什纳曾多次访问俄罗斯，但据称此次会谈将是首次在乌克兰举行。 泽伦斯基周四表示，“暂定日期已经确定”，美国特使将“在未来几天内”抵达基辅。 但乌克兰议员奥列克西·洪恰伦科表示，预计两人将于周日抵达乌克兰首都。他补充说，这将在他们周六访问莫斯科后发生。 俄罗斯国家通讯社塔斯社援引消息人士的话称，维特科夫和库什纳“预计将于 9 月 5 日至 6 日抵达莫斯科，然后抵达基辅”。 克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫后来告诉记者：“我不会宣布任何事情，但当这些接触发生时，我们会通知你们。” 与此同时，普京周四在一个国际经济论坛上表示，“有机会”达成和平协议。 但他没有表现出放弃其最高要求的迹象，其中包括乌克兰做出更多领土让步。 基辅及其欧洲盟友一再拒绝普京的条件，称这些条件无异于投降。 俄罗斯于2022年2月对乌克兰发动全面入侵，目前控制着乌克兰约20%的领土。

reflection.en: As US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff travel to Moscow and Kyiv, they carry the weight of seeking peace in a protracted conflict. The pursuit of peace, even when fraught with difficulty and stalled negotiations, is a calling that echoes the beatitude, 'Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.' May their efforts, and the...
reflection.zh: 随着美国特使贾里德·库什纳和史蒂夫·维特科夫前往莫斯科和基辅，他们肩负着在旷日持久的冲突中寻求和平的重任。“使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必得称为神的儿子。”这一句福音，呼应了和平的追求，即使在困难重重、谈判停滞之时。愿他们的努力，以及所有致力于缓和暴力的人的努力，都能得到智慧和真正和解的愿望的指引。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: UN votes to adopt new world map to reflect Africa's true size
title.zh: 联合国投票通过新世界地图以反映非洲的真实大小

summary.en: The UN General Assembly has voted to replace the traditional world map with one that more accurately reflects the size of Africa. The resolution, sponsored by Togo and backed by 164 nations, passed with the US being the only country to vote against it.
summary.zh: 联合国大会投票决定用更能准确反映非洲大小的新版世界地图取代传统地图。该决议由多哥发起，得到了164个国家的支持，美国是唯一投反对票的国家。

body.en:
The UN General Assembly has voted to replace the traditional world map with one that more accurately reflects the size of Africa.

The "Correct the Map" resolution, sponsored by Togo and backed by African Union (AU) members, passed with the support of 164 nations, including France and the UK. The United States was the only nation to vote against it - and there were six abstentions.

The UN vote is non-binding but will see changes to the maps used by institutions around the world.

The Mercator map, which has been in common use since the 16th Century, has come in for criticism as it shows Africa as similar in size to Greenland, even though it is 14 times larger.

Critics say this leads to the development needs and potential for countries near the equator to be minimised.

The Mercator map was designed in 1569 by the Flemish cartographer Gerardus Mercator to help European explorers navigate across the world.

The distortion of his map is a result of the fact that it is impossible to accurately represent the surface of a globe on a two-dimensional chart.

The Mercator map shows the curvature of the Earth by making countries near the equator seem smaller than they are, with countries nearer the poles appearing bigger.

In an effort to correct this, a team of cartographers in 2018 created an equal area map they called the Equal Earth projection.

In February, the AU's 54 member states adopted it, and said it "more accurately represents the sizes of all continents, particularly Africa".

Online campaign group #CorrectTheMap said: "You could fit the United States, China, India, Japan, Mexico and much of Europe into Africa and still have land to spare."

Ahead of Friday's vote, Togolese Foreign Minister Robert Dussey told the Reuters news agency: "A fair world begins with a fair map."

Earlier he had told a UN briefing: "A map is never neutral. It shapes perceptions, influences how the place of peoples and continents in the world is understood."

He had the backing of the French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot, who said his ministry was going to stop using the Mercator map , external .

"Changing the map obviously doesn't change the world. But correcting a representation that distorts it is already an act of truth," he said.

But Yaryna Ferencevych, a US representative at the UN, said the resolution mocked the work and purpose of the UN General Assembly , external .

"Instead of focusing on genuine problems of international peace, prosperity, or good relations, this body is debating map projects from the 16th Century, and their role in promoting reparations and 'cognitive justice'," she said.

In March, the US was also critical when a resolution was adopted declaring the transatlantic slave trade "the gravest crime against humanity".

"Africa's...
body.zh: 联合国大会投票决定用更准确反映非洲面积的地图取代传统的世界地图。 由多哥发起、非盟成员国支持的“修正地图”决议在法国、英国等164个国家的支持下获得通过。美国是唯一投反对票的国家，有六票弃权。 自 16 世纪以来一直广泛使用的墨卡托地图受到了批评，因为它显示非洲的面积与格陵兰岛相似，尽管非洲的面积是格陵兰岛的 14 倍。 批评人士称，这导致赤道附近国家的发展需求和潜力被最小化。 墨卡托地图由佛兰德斯制图师 Gerardus Mercator 于 1569 年设计，旨在帮助欧洲探险家在世界各地导航。 他的地图失真是因为不可能在二维图表上准确地表示地球表面。 墨卡托地图通过使赤道附近的国家看起来比实际小，而靠近两极的国家看起来更大来显示地球的曲率。 为了纠正这个问题，一组制图师于 2018 年创建了一张等面积地图，他们称之为“等地球投影”。 今年 2 月，非盟 54 个成员国通过了该标准，称其“更准确地代表了各大洲的面积，特别是非洲”。 在周五投票之前，多哥外交部长罗伯特·杜西告诉路透社：“公平的世界始于公平的地图。” 早些时候，他在联合国简报中表示：“地图从来都不是中立的。它塑造人们的看法，影响人们对世界上各民族和各大洲位置的理解。” 联合国的投票不具有约束力，但世界各地机构使用的地图将会发生变化。

reflection.en: For centuries, the common Mercator map has minimized the true scale of Africa, a distortion that subtly influences perceptions of global importance and development. The UN's decision to adopt a more accurate map, championed by Togo and supported by 164 nations, corrects this historical oversight. It reminds us that seeking and embracing truth, even in...
reflection.zh: 几个世纪以来，通用的墨卡托地图一直低估了非洲的真实规模，这种扭曲会微妙地影响人们对全球重要性和发展的看法。联合国采纳更准确地图的决定，由多哥倡导并得到164个国家的支持，纠正了这一历史性的疏忽。它提醒我们，追求和拥抱真理，即使是在地图绘制方面，对于一个公正和知情的_世界来说也是至关重要的。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: Outrage as Maltese tycoon acquitted in journalist's murder
title.zh: 震惊：马耳他巨头记者谋杀案无罪

summary.en: Maltese businessman Yorgen Fenech has been acquitted of complicity in the murder of journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia. The verdict, delivered nearly nine years after the attack, leaves the question of who ordered her death unresolved, sparking outrage from the public and the victim's family.
summary.zh: 马耳他商人尤尔根·费内赫被判无罪，此前他被指控共谋杀害记者达芙妮·卡鲁阿纳·加利齐亚。这起袭击事件发生近九年后，谁下令杀害她的问题仍未得到解答，这在公众和受害者家属中引发了愤怒。

body.en:
Maltese businessman Yorgen Fenech has been found not guilty of complicity to murder journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia. Almost nine years after the attack, the question of who ordered her death remains unanswered.

As Yorgen Fenech left the courthouse in Valletta on Wednesday evening, he was confronted by the furious crowd outside. The 44-year-old Maltese businessman pushed through, flanked by his security guards. Just minutes earlier, a jury had acquitted him of ordering the murder of the 53-year-old investigative journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia.

The verdict came as a shock to her family. Her son, Matthew Caruana Galizia, said it was a "terrible decision by the jurors that our country may never recover from." He later doubled down on his criticism, describing the verdict in a post on Facebook as "obscene" and saying: "Their decision flies in the face of all evidence, of all logic, of the truth."

Almost nine years after Caruana Galizia's murder, Malta is again confronted with the crucial question: Who was responsible for her death on October 16, 2017? The men who procured the bomb, placed it under the driver's seat and detonated it remotely have already been convicted . But the person who contracted them to do it has still not been legally identified.

For years, Fenech was considered to be the central figure in the investigations. His arrest on the morning of November 20, 2019, was like something out of a movie. His luxury yacht, Gio, had just left harbor when it was stopped by a Maltese military patrol boat. Fenech was arrested on board and subsequently interrogated by the police.

Fenech's arrest, and suspicion that people in government circles were involved in the crime, sparked protests all across the country. Joseph Muscat, prime minister at the time, was accused of protecting political allies and stepped down in January 2020. Fenech spent more than five years in detention before being released on bail, under strict conditions, in early 2025.

His trial only began this summer , and the final verdict was decisive. Eight of the nine jurors rejected the prosecution's argument that it was Fenech who had ordered the journalist's murder.

The prosecution case relied above all on the testimony of Melvin Theuma, who confessed to being the middleman and testified that Fenech had contracted him to organize the murder. Theuma received a pardon in exchange for his cooperation.

But Fenech's defense called Theuma's credibility into question, highlighting contradictions in his testimony and false statements he had made previously.

Fenech's lawyers also sought to prove that evidence pointing to Keith Schembri, chief of staff to Muscat at the time, was not properly followed up. Schembri has denied any involvement in the murder, and the...
body.zh: 马耳他商人约根·费内奇 (Yorgen Fenech) 被判无罪谋杀记者达芙妮·卡鲁阿纳·加利齐亚 (Daphne Caruana Galizia)。袭击发生近九年后，谁下令杀害她的问题仍然没有答案。 周三晚上，当约根·费内奇 (Yorgen Fenech) 离开瓦莱塔法院时，他遇到了外面愤怒的人群。这位 44 岁的马耳他商人在保安的簇拥下推门而入。就在几分钟前，陪审团宣布他下令谋杀 53 岁调查记者达芙妮·卡鲁阿纳·加利齐亚 (Daphne Caruana Galizia) 无罪。 这一判决令她的家人感到震惊。她的儿子马修·卡鲁阿纳·加利齐亚 (Matthew Caruana Galizia) 表示，这是“陪审团做出的可怕决定，我们的国家可能永远无法从中恢复过来”。后来他加大了批评力度，在脸书上发帖称这一判决“淫秽”，并表示：“他们的决定违背了所有证据、所有逻辑和事实。” 卡鲁阿娜·加利齐亚 (Caruana Galizia) 被谋杀近九年后，马耳他再次面临关键问题：谁应对 2017 年 10 月 16 日她的死亡负责？购买炸弹、将其放置在驾驶员座椅下并远程引爆的人已被定罪。但与他们签约的人的身份仍未得到合法确认。 多年来，费内奇被认为是调查的核心人物。他于2019年11月20日上午被捕，就像电影里的情节一样。他的豪华游艇“Gio”刚刚离开港口，就被一艘马耳他军事巡逻艇拦住。费内奇在船上被捕，随后受到警方审问。 费内奇被捕，以及政府人士涉嫌参与犯罪的怀疑，引发了全国各地的抗议活动。时任总理约瑟夫·马斯喀特 (Joseph Muscat) 被指控保护政治盟友，并于 2020 年 1 月下台。费内奇 (Fenech) 被拘留了五年多，然后于 2025 年初在严格条件下获得保释。 他的审判今年夏天才开始，最终的判决是决定性的。九名陪审员中的八名驳回了检方关于是费内奇下令谋杀记者的论点。 检方的指控首先依赖于梅尔文·西玛 (Melvin Theuma) 的证词，他承认自己是中间人，并证明芬内奇与他签约组织了这起谋杀案。作为合作的交换，Theuma 获得了赦免。 但费内奇的辩护对西玛的可信度提出了质疑，强调了他的证词中的矛盾以及他之前所做的虚假陈述。 费内奇的律师还试图证明指向当时马斯喀特参谋长基思·谢姆布里的证据没有得到适当的跟进。申布里否认与这起谋杀案有任何牵连，而且……

reflection.en: The acquittal of Yorgen Fenech in the murder of Daphne Caruana Galizia leaves a deep wound of injustice. The family's anguish and the public's fury underscore the cry for accountability when the legal system fails to deliver justice. This echoes Habakkuk's lament over a broken justice system, where the law is paralyzed and the wicked go unpunished.
reflection.zh: 尤尔根·费内赫在达芙妮·卡鲁阿纳·加利齐亚谋杀案中的无罪判决留下了深深的不公创伤。家属的痛苦和公众的愤怒，凸显了当法律体系未能伸张正义时，对问责制的呼喊。这呼应了哈巴谷对破碎司法体系的哀叹，即法律瘫痪而恶人逍遥法外。

verse.textEn: The law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
verse.textZh: 因此律法放松，公理也不显明；恶人围困义人，所以公理显然颠倒。

title.en: Six-week-old child in Pennsylvania dies from measles, coroner says
title.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州一名六周大的婴儿死于麻疹，验尸官称

summary.en: A six-week-old infant in Pennsylvania has died from measles, according to the Lancaster County coroner. This death follows two other measles-related fatalities in the county last week. The infant had Amish lethal microcephaly, a condition that can increase vulnerability to infections.
summary.zh: 兰开斯特县验尸官证实，宾夕法尼亚州一名六周大的婴儿死于麻疹。这是该县上周报告的两起与麻疹相关的死亡事件之后的又一例。该婴儿患有阿米什致死小头畸形症，这种情况会增加其感染的脆弱性。

body.en:
A six-week-old child in Pennsylvania died from measles, the Lancaster County coroner has determined, following two measles-related deaths in the county last week.

Stephen Diamantoni, the county coroner, confirmed the death to multiple news outlets and said that the infant had Amish lethal microcephaly. Children with the condition typically live to only five to six months, and the condition can make children more vulnerable to respiratory infections.

State health officials have not confirmed whether the six-week-old was one of the two deaths announced last week, according to the New York Times .

The first death, on 14 August, involved an infant whose mother had measles and transmitted it to the child.

In that case, the coroner told WGAL that a ruptured spleen, not measles, was the cause of death. Measles, however, was listed on the newborn’s death certificate, the outlet reported. The Atlantic reported that the parents believe their baby died from measles.

Pennsylvania has counted nearly 400 measles cases across 28 counties, nearly half of which are in southern Lancaster county. Most of the cases reported to state health authorities are in adults between 18 and 49. Official tallies are typically an undercount of actual cases.

At a news conference last week, Pennsylvania governor Josh Shapiro and state secretary of health Debra Bogen said two Lancaster county residents had died in cases described as “measles-associated”. They did not provide further details, citing privacy laws and respect for the deceased and their families.

The recent deaths have fueled a dispute between Shapiro, a Democrat, and health secretary Robert F Kennedy Jr.

Officials strongly suggested that the two deaths were caused by measles when they announced them, but the distinction of “measles-associated” led some on the right to dispute whether measles was actually the cause.

Shapiro had criticized Kennedy, a longtime vaccine skeptic, over his history of misinformation surrounding vaccines. The governor said that Kennedy’s rhetoric has not helped contain the measles epidemic, which has pushed US cases to the highest number in over three decades .

Kennedy responded by suggesting Shapiro’s side had fabricated the deaths in an effort to blame the health secretary. He also accused Democrats of using tactics similar to those employed during the pandemic to counter critics and encourage vaccination.

“The performance was a replay of the Democrats’ Covid playbook: fear-mongering, misinformation, finger-pointing, and the weaponization of infectious disease fears for political gain,” Kennedy wrote on social media .

As of Monday, top US health officials and government agencies were not including the two recent measles-associated deaths in their official counts. Kennedy also gave...
body.zh: 兰开斯特县验尸官确定，宾夕法尼亚州一名六周大的儿童死于麻疹，上周该县发生了两起与麻疹相关的死亡事件。 县验尸官斯蒂芬·迪亚曼托尼（Stephen Diamantoni）向多家新闻媒体证实了这起死亡事件，并表示婴儿患有阿米什致命小头症。患有这种疾病的儿童通常只能活五到六个月，而且这种疾病会使儿童更容易受到呼吸道感染。 据《纽约时报》报道，州卫生官员尚未确认这名六周大的婴儿是否是上周宣布的两例死亡病例之一。 8 月 14 日发生的第一例死亡涉及一名婴儿，其母亲患有麻疹并将其传染给了孩子。 在那起案件中，验尸官告诉 WGAL，死亡原因是脾脏破裂，而不是麻疹。然而，据该媒体报道，新生儿的死亡证明上列出了麻疹。据《大西洋月刊》报道，这对父母相信他们的孩子死于麻疹。 宾夕法尼亚州统计了 28 个县的近 400 例麻疹病例，其中近一半位于兰开斯特县南部。向州卫生当局报告的大多数病例都是 18 岁至 49 岁之间的成年人。官方统计数字通常低于实际病例数。 在上周的新闻发布会上，宾夕法尼亚州州长乔什·夏皮罗和州卫生部长黛布拉·博根表示，两名兰开斯特县居民死于“与麻疹相关”的病例。他们没有提供更多细节，理由是隐私法和对死者及其家人的尊重。 最近的死亡事件加剧了民主党人夏皮罗和卫生部长小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪之间的争端。 官员们在宣布这两起死亡事件时强烈暗示这两人是由麻疹引起的，但“与麻疹相关”的区别导致一些右翼人士质疑麻疹是否真的是死亡原因。 夏皮罗批评肯尼迪这位长期对疫苗持怀疑态度的人，指责他在疫苗方面的错误信息。州长表示，肯尼迪的言论无助于遏制麻疹疫情，麻疹疫情已将美国病例数推至三十多年来的最高水平。 肯尼迪回应称，夏皮罗的一方捏造了死亡事件，试图指责卫生部长。他还指责民主党使用与大流行期间类似的策略来反击批评者并鼓励疫苗接种。 肯尼迪在社交媒体上写道：“这场表演是民主党新冠剧本的重演：散布恐惧、错误信息、相互指责，以及将传染病恐惧武器化以获取政治利益。” 截至周一，美国高级卫生官员和政府机构并未将最近两起与麻疹相关的死亡人数纳入官方统计。肯尼迪还给...

reflection.en: The news of a six-week-old child succumbing to measles is a profound tragedy, underscoring the fragility of life and the devastating impact of preventable diseases. In such moments of grief and vulnerability, the call to pray for the sick, as James 5:14 suggests, offers a path toward comfort and communal support, acknowledging our shared humanity in the...
reflection.zh: 一名六周大的婴儿因麻疹去世的消息是一个巨大的悲剧，它凸显了生命的脆弱以及可预防疾病的毁灭性影响。在这些悲伤和脆弱的时刻，雅各书 5:14 呼吁为病人祷告，为我们提供了一条通往安慰和集体支持的道路，承认我们在面对苦难时的共同人性。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: Yemen: Fighting intensifies amid Houthi push in the west
title.zh: 也门：胡塞武装在西部加剧冲突

summary.en: Houthi forces are intensifying their fight to gain control of strategic high ground and the entrance to the Red Sea in southwestern Yemen. The Iran-backed militia broke off a fragile truce with the Saudi-backed government-in-exile in July, leading to renewed ground offensives and significant losses on both sides.
summary.zh: 胡塞武装正加剧争夺也门西南部战略高地和红海入口的控制权。受伊朗支持的该民兵组织于7月打破了与沙特支持的流亡政府之间脆弱的停火协议，导致双方遭受重大损失并重新爆发地面攻势。

body.zh: 胡塞武装正试图夺取制高点，巩固对西南部红海入口的控制。伊朗支持的民兵组织于七月份放弃了与沙特支持的流亡政府之间不稳定的休战协议。 也门长期内战双方都因胡塞民兵试图夺取西部红海门户的控制权而遭受损失。 伊朗支持的胡塞武装控制着首都萨那和该国大部分地区，周四对沙特阿拉伯领导的支持也门流亡政府的联盟发动地面攻势。 目前尚未正式公布伤亡数字，但新闻机构援引非公开消息人士的话说，双方均造成数十人伤亡，还有平民在战斗中丧生。截至周五，法新社统计有 129 人死亡。 官员们还报告说，炮击和炮火迫使数百个家庭逃离荷台达和莫卡这两个沿海城市，冲突双方都控制着这两个城市。 也门已经处于内战状态近12年了，今年7月在海湾地区与伊朗的战争中，一段相对平静的时期被打破。 胡塞武装的目标是沙特领导的部队控制的港口和高地，这将加强他们对曼德海峡的控制，该海峡是红海与亚丁湾的交汇处，通向阿拉伯海和公海。 它始终是一条重要的水道，在霍尔木兹海峡的交通受到限制的情况下，它的重要性变得更加重要。 胡塞武装宣布封锁接近沙特阿拉伯西海岸的船只，通过霍尔木兹进入沙特阿拉伯东部港口的通道已经受阻。但他们并没有处于理想的位置或能力来实现他们所表达的愿望。 然而，尽管他们对相关海岸线的控制并不完善，但他们已经向几艘商船开火，造成了一些严重损害和死亡。 军方消息人士私下告诉德新社和法新社，双方均造成多人伤亡。 DPA 统计的双方人数均为数十人，法新社则更准确地估计双方人数约为 60 人。 据报道，西南两个省份塔伊兹和荷台达发生了陆地交火以及火箭和无人机的交火。 胡塞武装控制着荷台达北部的主要西部港口，但也门西南端塔伊兹的大部分地区，包括海峡附近的莫卡港，都由沙特领导的部队控制。 美国风险咨询公司 Basha Report 的穆罕默德·巴沙 (Mohammed al-Basha) 告诉法新社：“他们的目标是巴布·曼德布 (Bab al-Mandeb)”。 争夺制高点，例如在努曼山上俯瞰......

reflection.en: The relentless cycle of conflict in Yemen, marked by the current Houthi push for control of the Red Sea entrance, underscores the devastating human cost of war. Amidst the sounds of battle and the breaking of truces, we are reminded of the prophetic vision of a world where weapons are rendered useless and peace prevails, a hope that sustains believers even...
reflection.zh: 也门冲突的无情循环，以胡塞武装当前争夺红海入口控制权的行动为标志，凸显了战争对人类造成的毁灭性代价。在战火和停火破裂的声音中，我们被提醒了那个武器被废弃、和平得以盛行的预言性景象，这一希望即使在最黑暗的时刻也能支撑信徒。

verse.textEn: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear.
verse.textZh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓断枪。

title.en: Argentine couple to return Nazi-looted painting to rightful owner
title.zh: 阿根廷夫妇将归还纳粹掠夺的画作给合法主人

summary.en: A painting, 'Portrait of a Lady,' lost for 80 years after being stolen by Nazis, was discovered in Argentina and a court has ruled it must be returned to the heir of its rightful owner. The current possessor, whose father was a Nazi fugitive, agreed to return it to avoid prosecution.
summary.zh: 一幅在纳粹时期被盗、失踪80年之久的画作《仕女肖像》在阿根廷被发现，法院已裁定必须将其归还给合法继承人。目前持有画作的人，其父亲曾是纳粹逃犯，为避免起诉而同意归还。

body.en:
A painting which was stolen by the Nazis and only recovered in Argentina last year must now be returned to the heir of its rightful owner, a court has ruled.

The late-baroque Portrait of a Lady was lost for 80 years until it was spotted in photographs of a house for sale near Buenos Aires.

The house belonged to Patricia Kadgien, the daughter of a Nazi fugitive who had fled there after the Second World War, and she has now agreed to return the painting in exchange for not being prosecuted for concealing it from the authorities.

Portrait of a Lady was among over 1,000 artworks looted from the collection of Jewish art dealer Jacques Goudstikker after the Nazi invasion of the Netherlands in 1940.

His daughter-in-law and sole heir Marei von Saher intends for the painting to be exhibited on a temporary loan at the Holocaust Museum of Buenos Aires to spread awareness of the issue, Argentine newspaper Clarin reports.

Von Saher has previously said her family "aims to bring back every single artwork robbed from Jacques' collection, and to restore his legacy".

This painting was first recognised in August 2025 by the Dutch Algemeen Dagblad (AD) newspaper on an estate agent's website of a property in the coastal town of Mar del Plata.

It was hanging above a green sofa in the living room of Patricia Kadgien, whose father Friedrich Kadgien had been a top adviser to Hermann Goring, Adolf Hitler's deputy. Goring plundered thousands of works across Europe.

Last September, Patricia Kadgien and her husband were charged with concealment and placed under house arrest after a search of her property initially failed to find the painting.

But at Friday's hearing in Mar del Plata, all criminal proceedings were suspended against the couple.

The agreement reached between the families and prosecutors means Kadgien and her husband will give up all rights to the artwork and must donate 4.8 million pesos (£2,356; $3,185) to local hospitals.

Portrait of a Lady, also known as Contessa Colleoni, is attributed to the work of the late-baroque artist Giuseppe Ghislandi.

However, experts have questioned the artwork's provenance, with some scholars attributing it to Giacomo Ceruti - another Italian artist from the same period.
body.zh: 法院裁定，去年才在阿根廷被纳粹盗走的一幅画现在必须归还给其合法所有者的继承人。 这幅巴洛克晚期的《女士肖像》失踪了 80 年，直到在布宜诺斯艾利斯附近一栋待售房屋的照片中被发现。 这所房子属于帕特里夏·卡吉恩 (Patricia Kadgien)，她是二战后逃亡到这里的纳粹逃犯的女儿，她现在同意归还这幅画，以换取不因向当局隐瞒这幅画而受到起诉。 1940 年纳粹入侵荷兰后，犹太艺术品经销商雅克·古德斯蒂克 (Jacques Goudstikker) 收藏的 1000 多件艺术品被掠夺，《一位女士的肖像》就是其中之一。 据阿根廷报纸 Clarin 报道，他的儿媳兼唯一继承人马雷·冯·萨赫 (Marei von Saher) 打算将这幅画临时借给布宜诺斯艾利斯大屠杀博物馆展出，以提高人们对这一问题的认识。 冯·萨赫此前曾表示，她的家人“旨在夺回雅克收藏中被盗的每一件艺术品，并恢复他的遗产”。 这幅画于 2025 年 8 月首次被荷兰 Algemeen Dagblad (AD) 报纸在沿海小镇马德普拉塔一处房产的房地产经纪人网站上识别。 它挂在帕特里夏·卡吉恩客厅的绿色沙发上方，她的父亲弗里德里希·卡吉恩曾是阿道夫·希特勒副手赫尔曼·戈林的高级顾问。戈林在欧洲各地掠夺了数千件作品。 去年九月，帕特里夏·卡吉恩 (Patricia Kadgien) 和她的丈夫被指控犯有藏匿罪，并在对她的财产进行搜查但最初未能找到这幅画后被软禁。 但周五在马德普拉塔举行的听证会上，针对这对夫妇的所有刑事诉讼均被暂停。 家人和检察官达成的协议意味着 Kadgien 和她的丈夫将放弃对艺术品的所有权利，并且必须向当地医院捐赠 480 万比索（2,356 英镑；3,185 美元）。 《一位女士的肖像》，也被称为 Contessa Colleoni，出自已故巴洛克艺术家朱塞佩·吉斯兰迪 (Giuseppe Ghislandi) 的作品。 然而，专家们质疑这件艺术品的出处，一些学者将其归因于同一时期的另一位意大利艺术家贾科莫·切鲁蒂(Giacomo Ceruti)。

reflection.en: The 'Portrait of a Lady' represents a tangible link to a dark past, a wrong that has persisted for decades. The court's ruling, and the agreement to return the artwork, speaks to a deep human and moral need for restitution and justice, even long after the initial crime. It echoes the prophet Micah's timeless call to 'do justice, and to love kindness, and to...
reflection.zh: 《仕女肖像》代表着一段黑暗历史的切实联系，一个持续了几十年的错误。法院的裁决以及归还这件艺术品的协议，体现了即使在最初的罪行很久之后，人们对于归还和伸张正义的深刻人类和道德需求。这呼应了先知弥迦那永恒的呼召：“只当公义行道，喜爱怜悯，谦卑与你的雅伟同行。”

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Europe targeted by spiralling campaign of sabotage - and Russia is the chief suspect
title.zh: 欧洲成为蓄意破坏活动的攻击目标——俄罗斯是主要嫌疑对象

summary.en: Germany has blamed Russia for an attack on Leipzig airport, but there has been a series of suspicious incidents elsewhere.
summary.zh: 德国指责俄罗斯袭击了莱比锡机场，但其他地方也发生了一系列可疑事件。

body.en:
As summer temperatures in Europe smashed records and many politicians shifted to holiday mode, Russia remained focused on its war.

Not only did its military attacks across Ukraine intensify last month, becoming ever more deadly for civilians, Russia also appears to have escalated its sabotage campaign across Europe.

A full month after drones packed with explosives were found at Leipzig's airport, used by Ukraine to transport military goods, Germany's interior minister has declared that "Russia is responsible".

Russia's President Vladimir Putin is demanding proof, as always, and his officials call the accusation "absurd".

But the drones were just a dramatic start. August then brought a series of suspicious fires at defence facilities from Italy to Estonia.

Some of the affected countries have already blamed Russia; others are still investigating and some fires may eventually be ruled accidental, exactly as such attacks are designed to seem.

"There are many, many signals that Russia is changing its strategy and intensifying its activities, including terrorist and sabotage activities," Marcin Kierwiński said, warning people to be on their guard.

10 August Bulgaria: A major fire breaks out at a warehouse of defence firm EMCO in Tryavna. In a statement, the company recalled previous blasts at its facilities which were investigated for links to Russia. "Human error is excluded," it said.

13 August Italy: A fire at KNDS Ammo Italy outside Rome triggers a large explosion.

The local prosecutor is looking into possible outside interference, La Repubblica newspaper reports. Publicly, his office will only confirm that a case has been opened for negligent disaster against "unknown persons".

15 August Estonia: The Milrem Robotics factory in Tallinn, which the Kyiv Post says supplies drones to Ukraine, goes up in flames. Two suspects are arrested.

Estonian Prime Minister Kristen Michal says the possibility of Russian sabotage is being "taking seriously" by investigators.

25 August Slovakia: Police announce they have averted an arson attack on a Ukrainian-owned drone manufacturer and seized a "large amount of incendiary mixture". The firm itself blames Russia and police arrest three suspects who they say were "following orders". Slovakia is Russia's close ally in Europe.

30 August Poland: A country which is heavily targeted for sabotage reports two more fires.

One is in Lublin at a company which produces helicopter components. Prime Minister Donald Tusk said arson "cannot be ruled out".

An attack on the drone producer, WB Group, is clearer cut. A masked man is caught on CCTV throwing incendiary devices. Tusk calls it a "continuation of Russia's escalatory activities".

The pattern has continued into September with two Bulgarians arrested in Munich,...
body.zh: 随着欧洲夏季气温打破纪录，许多政客转向度假模式，俄罗斯仍将注意力集中在战争上。 俄罗斯不仅上个月加强了对乌克兰的军事袭击，对平民造成的杀伤力越来越大，而且似乎还升级了在欧洲各地的破坏活动。 在莱比锡机场发现乌克兰用来运输军用物资的载有爆炸物的无人机整整一个月后，德国内政部长宣布“俄罗斯应对此负责”。 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京一如既往地要求提供证据，他的官员称这一指控“荒谬”。 但无人机只是一个戏剧性的开始。随后，从意大利到爱沙尼亚的国防设施发生了一系列可疑火灾。 一些受影响国家已经指责俄罗斯；其他人仍在调查，有些火灾最终可能被裁定为意外，正如此类袭击的设计初衷。 马尔钦·基尔温斯基说：“有很多很多迹象表明，俄罗斯正在改变其战略并加剧其活动，包括恐怖主义和破坏活动。”他警告人们保持警惕。 8 月 10 日保加利亚：特里亚夫纳国防公司 EMCO 的一个仓库发生重大火灾。该公司在一份声明中回顾了此前发生的设施爆炸事件，这些爆炸事件已被调查是否与俄罗斯有关。 “排除人为错误，”它说。 8 月 13 日，意大利：罗马郊外的 KNDS Ammo Italy 发生火灾，引发大爆炸。 据《共和报》报道，当地检察官正在调查可能的外部干扰。在公开场合，他的办公室只会确认针对“不明人士”的过失灾难案件已立案。 8 月 15 日 爱沙尼亚：塔林 Milrem 机器人工厂起火，《基辅邮报》称该工厂向乌克兰供应无人机。两名嫌疑人被捕。 爱沙尼亚总理克里斯汀·米哈尔表示，调查人员正在“认真对待”俄罗斯破坏的可能性。 8 月 25 日斯洛伐克：警方宣布，他们避免了针对一家乌克兰无人机制造商的纵火袭击，并缴获了“大量燃烧混合物”。该公司本身将责任归咎于俄罗斯，警方逮捕了三名嫌疑人，并称他们是“奉命”。斯洛伐克是俄罗斯在欧洲的亲密盟友。 8 月 30 日 波兰：一个遭受严重破坏的国家报告又发生两起火灾。 其中之一是在卢布林一家生产直升机零部件的公司。总理唐纳德·图斯克表示“不能排除纵火”。 针对无人机生产商 WB 集团的攻击更加明确。闭路电视拍到一名蒙面男子投掷燃烧装置。图斯克称其为“俄罗斯升级活动的延续”。 这种模式一直持续到九月，两名保加利亚人在慕尼黑被捕……

reflection.en: As Europe experiences a 'spiralling campaign of sabotage,' with Germany pointing to Russia as the culprit behind the Leipzig airport drone incident, the world watches a potential cycle of retaliation unfold. In such moments, the temptation to respond in kind is strong, yet the ancient wisdom calls us to a different path: 'Do not be overcome by evil, but...
reflection.zh: 随着欧洲经历一场“螺旋式升级的破坏活动”，德国指责俄罗斯是莱比锡机场无人机事件的幕后黑手，世界正关注着潜在的报复循环。在这样的时刻，以牙还牙的诱惑是巨大的，但古老的智慧呼唤我们走另一条道路：“不要被邪恶打败，反而要用善来打败邪恶。”这要求我们在面对侵略时，也要有分辨力和致力于缓和局势的决心。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Nigeria: Suspected oil thieves dead after inhaling fumes
title.zh: 尼日利亚：涉嫌盗油者吸入烟雾死亡

summary.en: A Nigerian environmental group reports that at least 37 people died while attempting to illegally siphon crude oil from a ship. Police confirmed a fatal incident but provided fewer details, stating that investigations are ongoing.
summary.zh: 尼日利亚一个环保组织称，至少有37人在试图非法从船上盗取原油时死亡。警方证实发生了致命事件，但提供的细节较少，并表示调查仍在进行中。

body.zh: 尼日利亚环保组织表示，至少有 37 人在试图从船上非法抽取原油时死亡。警方承认发生了一起致命事件，但提供的细节较少，称调查仍在继续。 尼日利亚一个环保非政府组织表示，在该国南部试图从一艘装货船上非法开采石油的过程中，至少有 37 人死亡。 青年与宣传中心表示，他们中的大多数人因吸入有害烟雾而死亡。 尼日利亚当局尚未公布死亡人数，但承认发生了一起致命事件，其中有人被杀，显然是在试图窃取原油时。 这起事件于周四夜间发生在该国南部石油资源丰富的尼日尔三角洲河流州的奥克里卡。 该环保组织表示，这起事件发生在码头，当时一艘船只正在通过哈科特港炼油厂从 Indorama Eleme 石化厂装载石油。死者是“疑似石油窃贼”，他们试图在“非法采油点”将石油转移到船上。 非政府组织青年与倡导中心援引志愿者网络的话说，还有其他人失踪，可能是在水中失踪了。 警方承认发生了一起事件，但表示他们将继续调查细节。 发言人布莱辛·阿格巴贝 (Blessing Agbabe) 表示：“河流州警察指挥部可以确认死亡事件。据称，受害者试图窃取原油。” 在非洲最大的石油生产国尼日利亚的尼日尔三角洲地区，石油盗窃相当普遍，该地区的石油矿区是贫困和环境退化的热点地区。 尼日利亚政府估计，石油盗窃行为每年造成数十亿美元的损失，并一直在努力打击这种行为。 如果得到证实，这将是至少自 2023 年 10 月以来有记录以来与企图盗窃石油有关的最严重的致命事故。 不过，尼日利亚安全和民防部队表示，流传的伤亡数字尚未得到证实，并表示正在与其他安全机构合作澄清细节。 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

reflection.en: The tragic deaths of 37 individuals attempting to steal oil underscore the desperate measures people may take when driven by economic hardship or greed. The Bible warns in 1 Timothy 6:10 that the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil, leading some to stray from the faith and pierce themselves with many pains. This incident serves as a somber reminder...
reflection.zh: 37人试图盗油身亡的悲剧，凸显了在经济困境或贪婪驱使下，人们可能采取的绝望手段。《圣经》在提摩太前书6章10节警告说，贪财是万恶之源，它使人离弃真道，用许多忧愁将自己刺透。这一事件令人痛心地提醒我们，非法致富的追求可能带来多么毁灭性的后果。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: Nepal flood disaster puts climate justice under spotlight
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪水灾难将气候正义推向聚光灯下

summary.en: Devastating Himalayan glacial floods have brought climate justice to the forefront, raising questions about responsibility and cost for climate-related disasters. The floods in Nepal's Bhotekoshi-Trisuli river basin have resulted in over 1,250 confirmed deaths, nearly 4,000 missing, and an estimated $2.6 billion in...
summary.zh: 毁灭性的喜马拉雅冰川洪水将气候正义推向了聚光灯下，引发了关于气候相关灾害责任和成本的问题。尼泊尔Bhotekoshi-Trisuli河流域的洪水已导致超过1250人确认死亡，近4000人失踪，并造成约26亿美元的基础设施损失，包括建筑物、桥梁、道路和水电设施。

body.en:
The devastating Himalayan glacial floods have raised broader questions about who should bear the costs and responsibility for the impacts of climate-related disasters.

Days after devastating floods swept through Nepal's Bhotekoshi-Trisuli river basin, the true scale of the disaster is still emerging.  

More than 1,250 people have been confirmed dead and almost 4,000 are still missing.

Buildings, bridges, roads and more than a dozen hydropower facilities have been destroyed, causing an estimated $2.6 billion (€2.24 billion) in damage to public and private infrastructure, according to the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA).

Search and rescue operations for missing people remain underway, with families still hoping for their safe return.

The exact cause of the glacial collapse remains unclear, but experts say climate change is causing glaciers to melt worldwide, increasing the risk of such disasters.

For Nepal, the disaster has raised a question that goes beyond rescue and reconstruction.

It's about climate justice and who should bear the costs and responsibility for such environmental disasters when the Himalayan nation contributes only a tiny fraction of global greenhouse gas emissions yet faces increasingly severe climate-related risks.

Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah said responding to the catastrophe is a "global responsibility."

"As we work tirelessly to address the damage caused by this sudden and massive disaster, a deeper question has also emerged: How did this destruction happen to us?" Shah asked while addressing Parliament this week.

"Mitigating and managing its impacts is regarded as a shared responsibility of the international community," he stressed.

Kathmandu is planning to raise climate justice issues in the upcoming United Nations General Assembly session in New York, where Prime Minister Shah himself is likely to lead the Nepali delegation.

"We will make our case about the impact of climate change and seek global support and moral obligation to tackle it," Nepal's Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal told DW. "We will also take the initiative of building a coalition of climate-vulnerable countries to raise our collective concerns."

Nepal, a largely rural nation of 30 million people, has contributed little to the greenhouse gas emissions driving global warming.

The country accounts for just 0.1% of global greenhouse gas emissions and emits about 0.5 tons of CO₂ per person each year, making it a "negligible contributor to climate change," according to the World Bank.

But the landlocked Himalayan nation is highly vulnerable to the effects of climate change, with...
body.zh: 毁灭性的喜马拉雅冰川洪水引发了更广泛的问题，即谁应该承担气候相关灾害影响的成本和责任。 毁灭性洪水席卷尼泊尔博特科希-特里苏里河流域几天后，灾难的真正规模仍在显现。 已确认超过 1,250 人死亡，近 4,000 人仍失踪。 据国家减少灾害风险和管理局 (NDRRMA) 称，建筑物、桥梁、道路和十多个水力发电设施被毁，造成公共和私人基础设施损失估计达 26 亿美元（22.4 亿欧元）。 失踪人员的搜救行动仍在进行中，家人仍希望他们能安全返回。 冰川崩塌的确切原因尚不清楚，但专家表示，气候变化正在导致全球范围内的冰川融化，增加了发生此类灾害的风险。 对于尼泊尔来说，这场灾难提出的问题超出了救援和重建的范围。 这是关于气候正义，以及当喜马拉雅国家只占全球温室气体排放量的一小部分却面临着日益严重的气候相关风险时，谁应该承担此类环境灾难的成本和责任。 尼泊尔总理巴伦德拉·沙阿表示，应对这场灾难是“全球责任”。 “当我们不知疲倦地努力解决这场突然发生的大规模灾难造成的损害时，一个更深层次的问题也出现了：这种破坏是如何发生在我们身上的？”沙阿本周在议会发表讲话时问道。 “减轻和管理其影响被视为国际社会的共同责任，”他强调。 加德满都计划在即将在纽约举行的联合国大会会议上提出气候正义问题，沙阿总理本人可能会率领尼泊尔代表团出席会议。 尼泊尔外交部长希西尔·卡纳尔对德国之声表示：“我们将阐述气候变化的影响，并寻求全球支持和道德义务来应对这一问题。” “我们还将主动建立气候脆弱国家联盟，以提出我们的集体关切。” 尼泊尔是一个拥有 3000 万人口、以农村为主的国家，对导致全球变暖的温室气体排放几乎没有造成什么影响。 据世界银行称，中国仅占全球温室气体排放量的 0.1%，每年每人排放约 0.5 吨二氧化碳，使其“对气候变化的影响可以忽略不计”。 但这个内陆喜马拉雅国家非常容易受到气候变化的影响，...

reflection.en: The earth itself groans, bearing the weight of human impact and the consequences of a fallen world. The devastating floods in Nepal, which have claimed so many lives and destroyed vital infrastructure, are a stark reminder of this reality. As we witness such tragedies, we are called to consider our stewardship of creation and the interconnectedness of our...
reflection.zh: 大地本身也在呻吟，承受着人类活动的影响和一个堕落世界的后果。尼泊尔毁灭性的洪水夺走了许多生命并摧毁了重要的基础设施，这是对这一现实的严峻提醒。当我们目睹这样的悲剧时，我们被呼召要反思我们对受造界的管理，以及我们行为与地球及其居民福祉之间的相互联系。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: El Niño is already wreaking havoc around the world — and it's only getting started
title.zh: 厄尔尼诺已在全球造成破坏——而这仅仅是开始

summary.en: The strengthening El Niño is already disrupting lives around the world, as the United Nations warns the "surging" climate pattern is raising the risk of months of heatwaves, floods, drought and extreme weather. The World Meteorological Organization (WMO) stated there is a "nearly 100 per cent" likelihood that El Niño...
summary.zh: 正在加强的厄尔尼诺现象已在全球范围内扰乱人们的生活，联合国警告称，这一“汹涌”的气候模式增加了未来数月出现热浪、洪水、干旱和极端天气的风险。世界气象组织（WMO）表示，厄尔尼诺现象“几乎有100%的可能性”将持续到明年二月，这是有史以来首次如此明确的厄尔尼诺更新。世界气象组织秘书长塞莱斯特·绍洛指出，自今年六月正式宣布...

body.en:
The strengthening El Niño is already disrupting lives around the world, as the United Nations warns the "surging" climate pattern is raising the risk of months of heatwaves, floods, drought and extreme weather.

On Thursday, the World Meteorological Organization (WMO) said there was a likelihood of "nearly 100 per cent" that El Niño will persist through to February, noting that this was the first time that an El Niño update had been so unequivocal.

The WMO's secretary-general, Celeste Saulo, said the climate driver, which was officially declared underway in June, has already dealt a blow to communities worldwide.

"We are already seeing disruption and devastation from droughts and floods and we expect these impacts to increase as El Niño intensifies," she said.

The phenomenon is expected to peak at very high intensity towards the end of the year — potentially at a record-breaking level — with lasting effects on the climate well into 2027 and the prospect of unprecedented global heat.

UN secretary-general António Guterres warned that El Niño is "being supersized before our eyes" by climate change.

"The science leaves no room for doubt: the planet is in uncharted waters, and those waters are heating up," Guterres said in response to the WMO update.

El Niño is associated with higher global temperatures and can bring drought and extreme heat to some regions while increasing rainfall and flood risks in others.

In Australia, El Niño typically increases the likelihood of hotter, drier conditions in the east and south-east, though its influence varies, and other climate factors also shape rainfall and temperatures.

Warmer-than-usual weather is expected across most of Australia through the spring.

More than a million students are learning remotely this week as toxic wildfire haze blankets parts of Indonesia, with officials warning that efforts to extinguish the blazes are entering a critical phase.

"Our problems are not over. September is the peak of El Niño," Indonesia's forestry minister Raja Juli Antoni told reporters this week.

El Niño is driving hotter, drier conditions in the region, intensifying a dry season that has seen thousands of hectares burnt.

Indonesian forest fire forensics expert Bambang Hero Saharjo told the BBC this year's El Niño-fuelled blazes could burn an area as large as 11 million hectares.

The haze has spread across parts of Southeast Asia, triggering health warnings and hospitalisations.

body.zh: 不断加强的厄尔尼诺现象已经扰乱了世界各地的生活，联合国警告称，这种“急剧上升”的气候模式正在增加持续数月的热浪、洪水、干旱和极端天气的风险。 周四，世界气象组织（WMO）表示，厄尔尼诺现象有“近100%”的可能性将持续到二月份，并指出这是第一次如此明确地更新厄尔尼诺现象。 世界气象组织秘书长塞莱斯特·索洛 (Celeste Saulo) 表示，6 月份正式宣布启动的气候驱动计划已经对世界各地的社区造成了打击。 她说：“我们已经看到干旱和洪水造成的破坏和破坏，预计随着厄尔尼诺现象的加剧，这些影响将会加剧。” 预计这种现象将在年底达到非常高的强度——可能达到破纪录的水平——对气候的持续影响将持续到 2027 年，全球可能会出现前所未有的高温。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯警告说，气候变化导致厄尔尼诺现象“在我们眼前变得更加严重”。 古特雷斯在回应世界气象组织的最新消息时表示：“科学不容置疑：地球正处于未知水域，而且这些水域正在升温。” 厄尔尼诺现象与全球气温升高有关，可能给一些地区带来干旱和极端高温，同时增加其他地区的降雨和洪水风险。 在澳大利亚，厄尔尼诺现象通常会增加东部和东南部出现更热、更干燥天气的可能性，尽管其影响各不相同，而且其他气候因素也会影响降雨量和气温。 预计整个春季澳大利亚大部分地区的天气将比平常温暖。 本周，有毒野火烟雾笼罩印度尼西亚部分地区，超过一百万学生正在远程学习，官员警告说，扑灭大火的努力正进入关键阶段。 “我们的问题还没有结束。九月是厄尔尼诺现象的顶峰，”印度尼西亚林业部长拉贾·朱利·安东尼本周告诉记者。 厄尔尼诺现象导致该地区气候变得更加炎热、干燥，加剧了旱季，导致数千公顷土地被烧毁。 印度尼西亚森林火灾法医专家 Bambang Hero Saharjo 告诉 BBC，今年厄尔尼诺现象引发的大火可能会烧毁面积达 1100 万公顷的土地。 雾霾已经蔓延到东南亚部分地区，引发健康警告和住院治疗。 邻国马来西亚卫生部报告称，由于空气质量问题，全国哮喘和结膜炎病例不断增加……

reflection.en: The world's climate system, like all of creation, groans under the weight of forces beyond its immediate control. The "disruption and devastation" wrought by El Niño serves as a stark reminder of our planet's vulnerability and interconnectedness. In these times of extreme weather, we are called to lament the brokenness we witness and to seek wisdom in...
reflection.zh: 世界的气候系统，如同所有被造物一样，在无法掌控的力量重压下发出呻吟。厄尔尼诺现象所带来的“混乱和毁灭”是地球脆弱性和相互关联性的一个严峻警示。在这些极端天气频发的时刻，我们被呼召为所见的破碎而哀恸，并在照管受托于我们的地球时寻求智慧。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: 'Back in miracle country': Two trapped workers rescued from Nepal hydropower tunnel
title.zh: 尼泊尔水电隧道：两人被困一周后奇迹般获救

summary.en: Two hydropower workers were rescued from a tunnel buried by debris in Nepal more than a week after catastrophic flooding, with officials estimating that at least 900 people remain trapped in similar situations.
summary.zh: 在尼泊尔发生灾难性洪水一周多后，两名水电工人从被瓦砾掩埋的隧道中获救。官方估计仍有至少900人被困在类似情况中。

body.en:
Two hydropower workers were pulled alive on Friday from a tunnel buried by debris in Nepal, a rare ray of hope on the tenth day of rescue efforts after catastrophic Himalayan flooding.

Rescuers cheered as one man was pulled through a muddy opening, a video released by the energy ministry showed.

He was helped to his feet by rescuers, and later carried on the backs of the emergency workers, raising his hand as they took him towards a helicopter.

A photograph showed the second man caked in mud, his hands pressed together in prayer, as rescuers carried him away on an orange stretcher.

"As long as there is breath, there is hope!" energy minister Biraj Bhakta Shrestha said in a statement.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"Rescue operations are continuing in all the affected tunnels. Let everyone's efforts and prayers continue. We have not lost hope."

Rescuers called it a "miracle" after the 26 August glacial and mountain collapse on the China-Nepal border killed at least 1,308 people and left more than 5,600 missing .

"I am so happy, my heart is lighter," Amir Maharjan, the brother of rescued worker Kabir Maharjan, told Agence France-Presse (AFP).

The rescued men, both Nepali, were named as Sanjay Sah, 30, a mechanical foreman, as well as Maharjan, 45, a mechanical supervisor, by home minister Sudan Gurung.

Sah, speaking on video broadcast on Nepali media shortly after his rescue, said he had survived by chanting Hindu prayers during the days in the dark.

"What day is today? I was chanting maha mantra inside," Sah said, adding that he believed more workers may be inside the tunnel.

"There were as many as 40 or 45 people ... I told them and everyone to run out," he said of the moment the disaster struck.

Both men were reported to be in stable condition, and were receiving treatment in a Kathmandu hospital, the energy ministry said.

The rescued pair were among hundreds of hydropower workers missing after a wall of mud and debris swept through the region on 26 August, following a massive glacial and rock collapse on a mountain on the China-Nepal border.

Searches continued at the Trishuli 3A tunnel, where the two men were rescued, as well as atmultiple other sites, with at least 12 hydropower projects smashed by the floods.

Extra soldiers had been sent on Friday to boost the search operation where the men were saved.

The government had initially said it believed more than 100 workers could be alive inside multiple tunnels.

Nepali rescuers, aided by experts from India, China and South Korea, had repeatedly hit walls of hard-packed debris in their search for survivors.

Australian rescue expert Arnold Dix, who has been supporting the...
body.zh: 尼泊尔政府部长表示，周五，两名水电工人从被废墟掩埋的隧道中被救出，距离灾难性洪水席卷该地区已经过去一周多了。 能源部发布的视频显示，一名男子被从泥泞的洞口中救出，救援人员欢呼雀跃。救援人员帮助他站了起来。 照片显示，第二名男子浑身是泥，双手合十祈祷，救援人员用橙色担架将他抬走。 尼泊尔内政部长苏丹古隆确认，这两名男子分别是 30 岁的机械工头桑杰·沙阿 (Sanjay Shah) 和 45 岁的机械主管卡比尔·马哈詹 (Kabir Maharjan)。 获救工人卡比尔·马哈詹 (Kabir Maharjan) 的兄弟阿米尔·马哈詹 (Amir Maharjan) 告诉法新社：“我很高兴，我的心轻松了。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 自8月26日泥浆和瓦砾席卷该地区以来，数百名水电工人失踪，两人是其中之一。 尼泊尔能源部长比拉吉·巴克塔·什雷斯塔 (Biraj Bhakta Shrestha) 证实，一名人员已从 Trishuli 3A 隧道中安全获救，不久之后又有一人获救。 古隆在一份声明中说：“我们刚刚收到消息称，还有一人……也获救。” 政府最初表示，相信多条隧道内可能有 100 多名工人还活着。 Trishuli 3A 和其他地点的搜索仍在继续。 中尼边境发生岩冰雪崩引发的巨浪，尼泊尔救援队已找到1250多具尸体，5000多人失踪。 澳大利亚救援专家阿诺德·迪克斯曾为多起隧道塌方救援提供建议，他一直在远程支持此次行动，并正在前往尼泊尔为地面救援人员提供支持。 周五早些时候，国际隧道和地下空间协会主席迪克斯表示，Trishuli 3A 水电项目的团队相信他们听到了隧道内微弱的反应。 他说救援人员已向隧道内喊话：“别担心，我们正在救你。” 迪克斯告诉法新社：“他们相信他们收到了来自内部的微弱回应，说‘预感’，是的或好的，”他补充说，他正在前往尼泊尔参加救援工作的途中。 “现在，我‘玻璃杯满了四分之三’……经过一周 24/7 的心痛，我们可能会回到奇迹的国度，”他说。 迪克斯说，团队已经挖开了堵塞隧道的碎片 50 到 60 米，并希望随时能够突破。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: After more than a week trapped in darkness and mud, Sanjay Shah and Kabir Maharjan were pulled from the Nepal hydropower tunnel, a moment of profound relief and joy for them and their families. Their rescue, described by ministers as a 'miracle,' echoes the biblical promise that weeping may last for the night, but joy comes with the morning. It is a...
reflection.zh: 在黑暗和泥泞中被困一周多后，桑杰·沙阿和卡比尔·马哈詹从尼泊尔的水电隧道中被救出，这对他们和他们的家人来说是巨大的解脱和喜悦。他们的获救被部长们称为“奇迹”，呼应了圣经中“哭泣或许会持续一夜，但早晨必带来欢欣”的应许。这证明了人类精神的韧性和救援人员的奉献精神，在仍有数百人被困的持续危机中带来了一线希望。

verse.textEn: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
verse.textZh: 一宿虽然有哭泣，早晨便必欢呼。

title.en: 'Beneath their office': Why the US-Canada dispute has turned so nasty
title.zh: “在他们的办公室下面”：美加争端为何如此恶劣

summary.en: A trade dispute between the US and Canada has spiralled into a bitter fight over tariffs, sovereignty and Donald Trump's threats.
summary.zh: 美加之间的贸易争端已演变成一场关于关税、主权和唐纳德·特朗普威胁的激烈斗争。

body.en:
What began as a trade fight between two of the world's most closely connected economies has escalated into a broader confrontation over Canada's sovereignty, culture and military, with United States President Donald Trump and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney now trading increasingly personal attacks.

The latest escalation follows the collapse of trade talks between the two countries on 21 August.

Canada walked away from negotiations after saying the US had made unacceptable last-minute demands, while the US has argued there was a deal on the table that Canada chose not to accept.

The US has since imposed 50 per cent tariffs on billions of dollars of Canadian goods, with Canada preparing retaliatory measures of its own.

Since then, the dispute has spilled well beyond trade . Trump has repeatedly suggested Canada should become the 51st US state, ordered US federal agencies to refer to Lake Ontario as "Lake America" and continued to attack Canadian leaders online.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

US officials have also mocked Canada's military, prompting Carney to accuse Washington of "doing memes", "throwing shade" and "trying to be tough".

But beneath the memes and insults is a serious economic standoff that both sides still say could ultimately be resolved at the negotiating table.

While Trump has imposed 50 per cent tariffs on about US$20 billion ($27 billion) worth of Canadian goods, Canada is preparing retaliatory tariffs of roughly the same value on US products from 8 September.

Carney says the US was seeking terms that would have left major Canadian industries, particularly the highly integrated auto sector, effectively operating as subsidiaries of US companies.

He has also accused the US of seeking changes that would affect Canada's French-language and cultural protections, as well as restrictions on Canada's ability to negotiate future free trade agreements with other countries.

Canada has rejected those demands as a threat to its economic interests and sovereignty.

The Trump administration disputes Canada's account of the negotiations and has argued that a deal was available that Canada chose not to accept.

Trump has repeatedly suggested that Canada should become the 51st US state, a proposal Canada has firmly rejected.

What might once have sounded like political provocation has become a central part of the dispute, with Carney increasingly framing the confrontation as a defence of Canadian sovereignty.

That rhetoric carries particular weight in Quebec, where there are concerns about what US absorption of Canada could mean for the province's French language and culture.

Carney has also pushed back against any suggestion...
body.zh: 世界上联系最紧密的两个经济体之间的贸易战一开始就升级为围绕加拿大主权、文化和军事的更广泛对抗，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和加拿大总理马克·卡尼现在越来越多地进行人身攻击。 最近的升级是在两国贸易谈判于 8 月 21 日破裂之后发生的。 加拿大在表示美国在最后一刻提出了不可接受的要求后退出了谈判，而美国则辩称有一项协议摆在桌面上，但加拿大选择不接受。 此后，美国对价值数十亿美元的加拿大商品征收50%的关税，加拿大也准备采取报复措施。 从那时起，争端已经远远超出了贸易范围。特朗普多次建议加拿大成为美国第51个州，命令美国联邦机构将安大略湖称为“美国湖”，并不断在网上攻击加拿大领导人。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 美国官员还嘲笑加拿大军队，促使卡尼指责华盛顿“搞迷因”、“投下阴影”和“试图强硬”。 但在这些表情包和侮辱背后是严重的经济僵局，双方仍然表示最终可以在谈判桌上解决。 尽管特朗普已对价值约200亿美元（约合270亿美元）的加拿大商品征收50%的关税，但加拿大正准备从9月8日起对美国产品征收大致相同价值的报复性关税。 卡尼表示，美国正在寻求一些条款，使加拿大主要工业，特别是高度一体化的汽车行业，能够作为美国公司的子公司有效运营。 他还指责美国寻求的改变会影响加拿大的法语和文化保护，并限制加拿大与其他国家谈判未来自由贸易协定的能力。 加拿大拒绝了这些要求，认为这是对其经济利益和主权的威胁。 特朗普政府对加拿大对谈判的描述提出质疑，并辩称加拿大选择不接受一项协议。 特朗普多次建议加拿大成为美国第51个州，但加拿大坚决拒绝了这一提议。 曾经听起来像是政治挑衅的事情已经成为争端的核心部分，卡尼越来越多地将这场对抗视为对加拿大主权的捍卫。 这种言论在魁北克尤其重要，人们担心美国吞并加拿大可能对该省的法语和文化意味着什么。 卡尼也反对任何建议……

reflection.en: When trade talks collapse and personal attacks replace reasoned debate, the path to peace becomes obscured. The principle of pursuing peace, even when difficult, calls for seeking common ground and de-escalating conflict, rather than allowing disputes to fester and grow.
reflection.zh: 当贸易谈判破裂，人身攻击取代了理性辩论时，和平之路变得模糊不清。追求和平的原则，即使在困难时，也呼吁寻求共同点并缓和冲突，而不是让争端恶化和蔓延。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Watch: Moment workers are rescued from Nepal tunnel
title.zh: 视频：尼泊尔隧道工人获救瞬间

summary.en: Rescuers pull two people from a hydropower tunnel more than a week after a massive flash flood devastated the Nepal-China border.
summary.zh: 在导致尼泊尔-中国边境地区遭受毁灭性洪灾一周多后，救援人员从一座水电站隧道中救出了两人。

reflection.en: In the aftermath of disaster, the focus often shifts to the immense scale of destruction. Yet, amidst the rubble and the waiting, the rescue of two individuals from the Nepal tunnel shines a light on the preciousness of each human life. Jesus taught that whatever we do for the least of these, we do for Him.
reflection.zh: 在灾难的余波中，人们的注意力常常转向巨大的破坏规模。然而，在瓦砾和等待之中，从尼泊尔隧道中救出两名个人的事件，彰显了每个人的生命都何等宝贵。耶稣教导说，凡你们为我这些最小的弟兄做的，就是为我做的。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: ‘Everyone seems to have forgotten’: In Tibet, flood-hit families search for the missing and grapple with China’s silence
title.zh: 在西藏，“每个人似乎都已忘记”：洪水肆虐家庭寻找失踪者，并与中国的沉默作斗争

summary.en: Relatives are trying to gather information online and from Nepal, while Tibet advocacy groups report that information is being suppressed in China. Fan Hong last heard from her husband, Lin Bo, who was working on a Chinese highway project in Nepal, on the morning of the disaster. Over a week later, she is desperately...
summary.zh: 亲属们正试图从网上和尼泊尔收集信息，而西藏倡导团体则报告信息在中国受到压制。范红在尼泊尔-西藏灾难发生当晚听到了她丈夫林波的消息，林波当时正在尼泊尔的一个中国公路项目上工作。一周多过去了，她仍在绝望地寻找他，难以从当局那里获得信息，并转向了社交媒体。

body.en: Relatives try to piece together information found online and from Nepal as Tibet advocates groups say information is suppressed in China Fan Hong last heard from her husband on the morning of the Nepal-Tibet disaster. More than a week later, the 31-year-old is desperately searching for information about Lin Bo, who was working on a Chinese highway project in Nepal. Struggling to get information from authorities, Fan turned to social media for help. “My husband works on a project in Nepal, about 5 kilometres from the Gyirong border crossing. I want to know what the situation is, but I haven’t been able to reach him,” the 31-year-old from China’s Sichuan province wrote on Rednote. Continue reading...
body.zh: 亲戚们试图将网上和来自尼泊尔的信息拼凑起来，因为西藏倡导团体称信息在中国受到压制。 范红最后一次听到她丈夫的消息是在尼泊尔-西藏灾难发生的早上。一个多星期后，这位31岁的男子正在拼命寻找有关林波的信息，林波正在尼泊尔的一个中国高速公路项目上工作。由于难以从当局获取信息，范向社交媒体寻求帮助。 “我丈夫在尼泊尔的一个项目工作，距离吉隆口岸约 5 公里。我想知道情况如何，但一直联系不上他，”这位来自中国四川省的 31 岁男子在 Rednote 上写道。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the aftermath of the Nepal-Tibet disaster, families like Fan Hong's are left in agonizing uncertainty, struggling to find information about their missing loved ones. The silence from authorities and the difficulty in accessing news echo the plight of those who are often voiceless. This situation calls us to remember and advocate for those whose suffering...
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔-西藏灾难发生后，像范红这样的家庭陷入了痛苦的不确定之中，努力寻找失踪亲人的信息。当局的沉默和获取新闻的困难，呼应了那些常常无声者的困境。这种情况提醒我们要铭记并为那些可能被遗忘的受苦者发声，这体现了圣经中为不能为自己发声者说话的呼召。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Pacific leaders voice concern over Chinese missile test but stop short of condemnation
title.zh: 太平洋领导人对中国导弹试验表示担忧，但未予谴责

summary.en: The Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) concluded with most member nations agreeing to "register concern" over China's recent intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) test, which overflew several members without adequate notice. Leaders urged transparency and advance notification for such tests, with Nauru being the sole...
summary.zh: 太平洋岛国论坛（PIF）闭幕，多数成员国同意就中国近期洲际弹道导弹（ICBM）试验“表示关切”，该试验在未获充分通知的情况下飞越了部分成员国领土。领导人敦促所有进行ICBM试验的国家确保透明度和保障，包括按照国际惯例至少提前24小时发出通知。18个成员国中，瑙鲁是唯一一个对此条款持异议的国家。

body.en:
The Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) has wrapped up with most nations agreeing to "register concern" on China's recent intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) test, "which overflew a number of members without adequate notice".

"Leaders call on all states undertaking ICBM testing to ensure transparency and reassurance, including through the provision of advance notification of a test at least 24 hours in accordance with international practice," the communique says, as read out by Palau's President and PIF chair Surangel Whipps Junior, after the closing ceremony.

In a rare move for the usually consensus-based forum, Nauru was the only one of 18 PIF members to dissent from the clause.

Kiribati and Nauru were the only two Pacific nations that had previously blocked a draft PIF statement in the immediate aftermath of Beijing's test, a move that Prime Minister Anthony Albanese had been advocating for.
