However the statement went further than analysts and government sources had expected; the PIF foreign ministers' meeting statement in August was broader, discussing ballistic missile testing in the region, but had stopped short of singling out a particular ICBM or referencing a notice period for nations to undergo any testing.

Whipps also hit back against China's comments that Palau sensationalised its ballistic missile test, saying: "There's no sensationalism, it's just stating the facts."

"The Pacific Islands weren't informed [of the test]. The ones that were informed were informed late, and so I think the message from the forum is clear: that transparency needs to happen."

Intelligence shows the nuclear-capable intercontinental ballistic missile test in July flew over the Philippines, Palau and Micronesia's airspace before landing in the Pacific Ocean.

The response has become something of a litmus test for PIF and its members for their strategic positioning.

The communique's relevant clause includes a reference to the Fiji-led Ocean of Peace declaration made last year, which states the region should be free from coercion and militarisation.

However, it doesn't name China, nor does it use heftier diplomatic language than "concern".

While Australian officials were happy with the agreed statement, it fell short of some pre-retreat expectations, including those of the host, Palau.

"They sent a missile next to French Polynesia, another one next to Tuvalu, crossing over our airspace. They never bothered to tell us that's what's happening," he said.

"I said 'there's a lot of space between Japan and Guam, why don't you send it there? Why does it have to come to the middle of the Pacific when last year we just signed a...
body.zh: 太平洋岛屿论坛（PIF）结束时，大多数国家同意对中国最近的洲际弹道导弹（ICBM）试验“表达关切”，“该试验在没有充分通知的情况下飞越了一些成员国”。 帕劳总统兼太平洋岛国论坛主席苏兰吉尔·惠普斯·儒尼奥尔在闭幕式后宣读的公报称，“领导人呼吁所有进行洲际弹道导弹测试的国家确保透明度和保证，包括根据国际惯例至少提前 24 小时提前通知测试情况”。 对于这个通常以共识为基础的论坛来说，这是一个罕见的举动，瑙鲁是 18 个 PIF 成员中唯一不同意该条款的国家。 基里巴斯和瑙鲁是此前在北京试验后立即阻止PIF声明草案的仅有的两个太平洋国家，此举是总理安东尼·阿尔巴内斯一直倡导的。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 然而，该声明超出了分析师和政府消息人士的预期；太平洋岛国论坛外交部长八月份的会议声明范围更广，讨论了该地区的弹道导弹试验，但没有单独指出特定的洲际弹道导弹或提及各国进行任何试验的通知期。 惠普斯还反驳了中国关于帕劳炒作其弹道导弹试验的言论，他说：“没有煽情，只是陈述事实。” “太平洋岛屿没有被告知（这次测试）。那些被告知的人却很晚才被告知，所以我认为论坛传达的信息很明确：需要实现透明度。” 情报显示，7月份进行的具有核能力的洲际弹道导弹试验飞越了菲律宾、帕劳和密克罗尼西亚的领空，然后降落在太平洋上。 这一回应已成为 PIF 及其成员战略定位的试金石。 公报的相关条款包括提及斐济去年发表的《和平海洋宣言》，该宣言指出该地区不应受到胁迫和军事化。 然而，它没有点名中国，也没有使用比“关切”更重的外交语言。 虽然澳大利亚官员对商定的声明感到满意，但它没有达到一些退会前的预期，包括东道主帕劳的预期。 “他们向法属波利尼西亚发射了一枚导弹，又向图瓦卢发射了一枚导弹，飞越了我们的领空。他们从来没有费心告诉我们发生了什么，”他说。 “我说‘日本和关岛之间有很大的空间，你为什么不把它送到那里？为什么它必须来到太平洋中部，去年我们刚刚签署了一份……

reflection.en: The leaders of the Pacific Islands Forum have expressed concern over a recent ICBM test that flew over their territories without sufficient warning. Their call for transparency and advance notification echoes the ancient prophetic vision of a world where such instruments of potential conflict are managed with greater care and consideration for all nations....
reflection.zh: 太平洋岛国论坛的领导人对近期一次未获充分预警便飞越其领土的洲际弹道导弹试验表示关切。他们呼吁提高透明度和提前通知，这呼应了古代先知的异象——一个世界，在那里，潜在冲突的工具能够得到更谨慎的处理，并顾及所有国家。 这一时刻凸显了国家安全利益与地区稳定之间的微妙平衡，敦促在国际事务中走上更加开放和相互保证的道路。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Reform’s media presenter worked for Chinese state propaganda channel
title.zh: 改革派媒体主持人曾在中国国家宣传频道工作

summary.en: Reform UK's top media presenter, Ray Addison, who hosts the party's podcast and social media campaigns, has worked for a Chinese state propaganda channel within the past year. Addison presented films about Xinjiang province, where China faces accusations of genocide, for state media in September 2025.
summary.zh: 据《卫报》报道，英国改革党（Reform UK）的首席媒体主持人雷·阿迪森（Ray Addison）在过去一年中曾为中国国家宣传频道工作。阿迪森曾于2025年9月为中国官媒制作了关于新疆省的影片，而中国在该地区面临种族灭绝的指控。

body.en: Party podcast and social media host Ray Addison fronted films about province where China is accused of genocide Reform UK’s top media presenter has worked for a Chinese state propaganda channel within the past year, the Guardian can reveal. Ray Addison, who presents the political party’s in-house podcast and social media campaigns, fronted films about Xinjiang province – where the Chinese government is accused of committing genocide – for state media in September 2025. Continue reading...
body.zh: 据《卫报》透露，党播客和社交媒体主持人雷·艾迪生 (Ray Addison) 主持了有关中国被指控进行种族灭绝的省份的电影。 《改革英国》(Reform UK) 顶级媒体主持人去年曾在中国国家宣传频道工作。负责该政党内部播客和社交媒体活动的雷·艾迪生 (Ray Addison) 于 2025 年 9 月为官方媒体播放了有关新疆省（中国政府被指控实施种族灭绝）的电影。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news that a political party's media presenter has worked for a state propaganda channel raises questions about truthfulness and integrity in public communication. Ephesians 4:25 calls believers to "put off falsehood and speak truthfully to one another," a principle vital for maintaining trust in political discourse and media.
reflection.zh: 一名政党媒体主持人曾为国家宣传频道工作的消息，引发了关于公共传播中真实性和诚信的疑问。以弗所书4章25节呼吁信徒“各人与邻舍说实话”，这一原则对于在政治言论和媒体中维持信任至关重要。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: Malaysia's middle path between China and US faces new tests
title.zh: 马来西亚在中国和美国之间走中间道路面临新考验

summary.en: Malaysia's Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim's recent comments on Taiwan and US-backed military facilities have raised questions about the sustainability of the nation's non-aligned foreign policy as US-China rivalry intensifies in Southeast Asia.
summary.zh: 马来西亚总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣最近就台湾和美国支持的军事设施发表的言论，在美中竞争日益加剧的东南亚地区，引发了对该国不结盟外交政策可持续性的质疑。

body.en:
The prime minister's comments on Taiwan and US-backed military facilities near Sabah have revived questions over Malaysia's non-aligned foreign policy.

Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim has spent much of his time in office insisting that Kuala Lumpur will not be forced to choose between the United States and China .

But two sets of comments last month have raised questions about how sustainable that position is as rivalry between the two superpowers increasingly spills into Southeast Asia.

"I see Taiwan as part of China, period," he said in an interview with news outlet Al Jazeera that aired on August 16.

Beijing considers democratically governed  Taiwan part of its territory. While Chinese leaders say they favor "peaceful reunification," they have never ruled out using force to bring the island under Beijing's control.

More controversially, Anwar appeared to accept Beijing's argument that force could be necessary.

"If one province decides to break away. Do we use force? I think I will, [to] protect the sanctity and unity of the nation," he said.

The comments drew an enthusiastic response from Beijing, while Taiwan's Foreign Ministry accused Anwar of effectively legitimizing the use of force against the island and warned that his "one-sided support for China could negatively impact Taiwanese businesses' confidence in investing in Malaysia," including in the country's strategically important semiconductor sector.

Two days after his comments on Taiwan aired, Anwar argued that Malaysia  should strengthen its defenses in Sabah, citing the expansion of US-backed military facilities on the nearby Philippine island of Balabac.

The Philippines is upgrading facilities on Balabac, roughly 50 kilometers (31 miles) from the Malaysian islands of Banggi and Balambangan.

Balabac was one of four additional locations added in 2023 to the Enhanced Defense Cooperation Agreement, which allows US forces to access designated Philippine military facilities, construct infrastructure and pre-position equipment.

Taken together, Anwar's comments raised concerns that Malaysia is growing warmer toward Beijing while becoming more suspicious of Washington's military footprint in the region.

Kuala Lumpur has also been one of the region's strongest critics of Israel's actions in Gaza . Anwar has repeatedly accused the United States and European governments of hypocrisy and double standards for championing democracy and international law while failing, in his view, to hold Israel sufficiently accountable.

But Malaysia experts warn against interpreting Anwar's rhetoric as evidence of a fundamental strategic realignment.

"Malaysia still maintains very good relations with the US and other Western countries," Ngeow Chow Bing, director of the Institute...
body.zh: 总理对台湾和沙巴附近美国支持的军事设施的评论再次引发了对马来西亚不结盟外交政策的质疑。 马来西亚总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣(Anwar Ibrahim)在任期间大部分时间都坚称，吉隆坡不会被迫在美国和中国之间做出选择。 但上个月的两套评论引发了人们的疑问，随着两个超级大国之间的竞争日益蔓延到东南亚，这一立场的可持续性如何。 “我认为台湾是中国的一部分，就这样，”他在接受半岛电视台 8 月 16 日播出的采访时说道。 北京认为台湾是其领土的一部分，实行民主治理。尽管中国领导人表示支持“和平统一”，但他们从未排除使用武力将该岛置于北京的控制之下。 更具争议性的是，安瓦尔似乎接受了北京关于可能需要使用武力的论点。 “如果一个省决定脱离。我们会使用武力吗？我想我会，[以]保护国家的神圣和统一，”他说。 这些言论引起了北京的热烈回应，而台湾外交部则指责安瓦尔实际上使对台湾使用武力合法化，并警告说，他“对中国的片面支持可能会对台湾企业投资马来西亚的信心产生负面影响”，包括对该国具有重要战略意义的半导体行业的投资。 在发表有关台湾的言论两天后，安瓦尔认为马来西亚应该加强在沙巴的防御，并列举了美国支持的在附近的菲律宾巴拉巴克岛扩建军事设施的情况。 菲律宾正在升级巴拉巴克岛的设施，该岛距离马来西亚班吉岛和巴兰班安岛约 50 公里（31 英里）。 巴拉巴克是 2023 年《增强防务合作协议》新增的四个地点之一，该协议允许美军进入菲律宾指定军事设施、建设基础设施和预置设备。 总而言之，安瓦尔的言论引发了人们的担忧，即马来西亚对北京的态度越来越好，同时对华盛顿在该地区的军事足迹越来越怀疑。 吉隆坡也是该地区对以色列在加沙行动最强烈的批评者之一。安瓦尔一再指责美国和欧洲政府在倡导民主和国际法方面虚伪和双重标准，同时他认为，未能让以色列承担足够的责任。 但马来西亚专家警告不要将安瓦尔的言论解读为根本战略调整的证据。 “马来西亚仍然与美国和其他西方国家保持着非常良好的关系，”该中心主任Ngeow Chow Bing...

reflection.en: Malaysia's Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim seeks to navigate a delicate path between global powers, aiming to avoid choosing sides. This pursuit of balance reflects a desire for peace and stability in a complex geopolitical landscape. The challenge lies in upholding this 'middle path' when external pressures mount, testing the nation's resolve to foster good...
reflection.zh: 马来西亚总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣试图在两大全球势力之间走一条微妙的道路，力求不选边站队。这种寻求平衡的努力，反映了在复杂的地缘政治格局中对和平与稳定的渴望。当外部压力增大时，如何坚持这条“中间道路”并促进与各方的良好关系，是对国家决心的考验。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Dozens of trapped hydropower tunnel workers in Nepal could still be alive, official says
title.zh: 尼泊尔水电隧道数十名被困工人仍有可能活着，官员称

summary.en: Approximately 46 workers are believed to be trapped in a 'room-like' structure within a hydropower plant tunnel on the Nepal-Tibet border following deadly flash floods. A Nepal electricity authority official expressed hope that many could still be found alive after a week.
summary.zh: 在致命的山洪暴发后，约有46名工人被认为被困在尼泊尔-西藏边境水电站隧道内的一个“房间状”结构中。尼泊尔电力局的一名官员表示，希望许多人在一周后仍能被发现活着。

body.en: About 46 people believed to be trapped in ‘room-like’ structure inside hydro plant tunnel on Nepal-Tibet border After the flood: human suffering on an unfathomable scale in Nepal’s worst-hit districts Nepal authorities have said they are “confident” that dozens of workers in Nepal’s Rasuwagadhi hydropower plant are still alive, more than a week after deadly flash floods left them trapped in an underground chamber. Authorities said that at least 639 workers were still missing from hydropower plants built along Nepal’s Bhote Koshi and Triushuli rivers. Continue reading...
body.zh: 尼泊尔与西藏边境的水电站隧道内约有 46 人被困在“类似房间”的结构中 洪水过后：尼泊尔受灾最严重的地区的人们遭受了难以估量的痛苦 一名尼泊尔电力局官员表示，在致命的山洪爆发后，数十名工人被困在尼泊尔拉苏瓦加迪水电站的地下密室中一周后，很可能会发现数十名工人还活着。尼泊尔电力局董事会成员阿姆苏·基兰·沙希 (Amhsu Kiran Shahi) 周三对路透社表示：“在拉苏瓦加迪，我们认为有 46 人被困在隧道内一个类似房间的结构中。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the face of disaster, the immediate concern is for the lives of those trapped. Amidst the uncertainty and fear, there is a flicker of hope that these 46 workers might still be found alive. This situation calls to mind Psalm 46:1, reminding us that even in overwhelming crises, God is our refuge and strength.
reflection.zh: 面对灾难，当务之急是那些被困者的生命。在不确定和恐惧之中，人们怀着一丝希望，希望这46名工人仍能被活着找到。这种情况让人想起诗篇46:1，提醒我们即使在压倒性的危机中，雅伟也是我们的避难所和力量。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: China’s demise was gleefully predicted by the west – meanwhile, it built an AI revolution | Larry Elliott
title.zh: 西方曾欢欣鼓舞地预言中国将衰落——与此同时，中国却掀起了一场人工智能革命

summary.en: Free AI models that rival expensive US versions are poised to disrupt global markets, offering a lesson for Britain. While Western predictions of China's economic demise have been frequent, focusing on issues like overinvestment, debt, property collapse, and political repression, China has quietly been building a...
summary.zh: 免费且媲美昂贵美国版本的人工智能模型将颠覆全球市场，并给英国带来启示。尽管西方对中国经济的衰落预测不绝于耳，聚焦于过度投资、债务、房地产崩溃和政治压迫等问题，中国却在悄然掀起一场人工智能革命。

body.en: Free AI models that are as good as the investment-hungry US versions will disrupt global markets, and offer Britain a lesson Almost from the moment it began, the end of the Chinese economic miracle has been much anticipated. Thick and fast, the books have come explaining how it will end badly. Overinvestment. A country wallowing in debt. The collapse of the property market . Political repression. The demand for democracy from a growing middle class. All have been put forward as reasons for the inevitable terminal crisis. Even those impressed by the country’s rapid growth took comfort from the notion that the west would continue to dominate advanced manufacturing while China would be stuck assembling TVs. And while the wait for its much-predicted demise has gone on and on, China has become the workshop of the world. Larry Elliott is a Guardian columnist Continue reading...
body.zh: 与渴望投资的美国版本一样好的免费人工智能模型将扰乱全球市场，并为英国提供一个教训。几乎从它开始的那一刻起，人们就一直在期待中国经济奇迹的结束。厚厚的书很快就来了，解释了它将会如何糟糕的结局。过度投资。一个深陷债务泥潭的国家。房地产市场崩溃。政治镇压。不断壮大的中产阶级对民主的需求。所有这些都被认为是不可避免的终极危机的原因。即使是那些对中国的快速增长印象深刻的人也因西方将继续主导先进制造业而中国将陷入电视机组装的困境而感到安慰。尽管人们对它的消亡的等待一直在持续，但中国已经成为世界工厂。拉里·埃利奥特是《卫报》专栏作家继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence in China, as described in the article, mirrors the prophetic vision of Daniel where knowledge would increase in the end times. This technological surge, while impressive, calls us to consider the wisdom and ethical frameworks guiding its development and application. May we seek to use these powerful tools for...
reflection.zh: 文章所描述的中国人工智能的飞速发展，与但以理书中关于末世知识增长的预言相呼应。这场技术浪潮虽然令人瞩目，却也促使我们反思指导其发展和应用的智慧与伦理框架。愿我们寻求以造物主的智慧与秩序为榜样，善用这些强大的工具。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: The shifting ties in Australia's backyard as 'deep pockets' beckon
title.zh: 澳大利亚后院的变动关系：‘深口袋’的诱惑

summary.en: While China stirs tensions over Taiwan in Palau, island leaders are urging Canberra to focus on climate and drug crime.
summary.zh: 在中国试图在帕劳挑起关于台湾的紧张局势之际，岛屿领导人正敦促堪培拉关注气候变化和毒品犯罪。

body.en:
China and Taiwan's diplomatic tug-of-war is casting a shadow over the ongoing Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) as a handful of national leaders declined to attend — however, experts on the ground caution that a geopolitical focus risks ignoring the core priorities of Australia's neighbours.

The annual 18-member gathering in the Taiwanese-allied nation of Palau opened on Monday with climate change, economic security, and the rising influence of the transnational drug trade top of the agenda.

China has said it has "serious concerns" that Taiwan was invited to attend in its own right, while questions have been raised about whether China has influenced five of 18 national leaders from the forum (those of Kiribati, Fiji, Vanuatu, Samoa and Solomon Island) not to attend.

The cornerstone regional political forum began this year with a pointed message from Palau's President Surangel Whipps Jr, who urged nations to adhere to this year's theme of unity and reminded outside partners that they "do not choose our destination".

This year's PIF takes place as Kiribati moves to constitutionally restrict diplomatic recognition to UN member states only — thus excluding Taiwan — while China actively seeks to strip Taiwan of its 'development partner' status in the forum. This comes nearly two months after a Chinese ballistic missile test in the Pacific Ocean .

But despite the noise around China, "leaders have made it clear they're here to work" Tess Newton Cain, principal consultant at Asia-Pacific strategic firm Sustineo, told SBS News from Koror.

"The issue of the China-Taiwan tussle is largely a distraction, and one that they try to minimise."

title.en: Can communities be proteced from melting glaciers?
title.zh: 社区能否免受冰川融化的影响？

summary.en: Rising temperatures are increasing the risk of floods and avalanches in mountain regions. The disaster in Nepal and Tibet shows the urgent need for solutions, and the tools that could help save lives.
summary.zh: 日益升高的气温增加了山区发生洪水和雪崩的风险。尼泊尔和西藏的灾难表明，迫切需要解决方案以及可能有助于挽救生命的工具。

body.en:
Rising temperatures are increasing the risk of floods and avalanches in mountain regions. The disaster in Nepal and Tibet shows the urgent need for solutions, and the tools that could help save lives.

High mountain glaciers formed in the ice age are retreating and becoming unstable as the burning of fossil fuels heats the climate and leads to a decline in snowfall.

The instability creates the conditions for large glacial sections to collapse, triggering ice and rock avalanches that can dam river valleys before tidal waves of water are released.

Following the glacier collapse that triggered what is known as a mountain tsunami in Nepal and Tibet on August 26 , thousands are still missing and feared dead. Unlike the 2025 glacier avalanche that destroyed the town of Blatten in Switzerland — where nearly all inhabitants were evacuated — a lack of early warning systems in the Himalayas left locals and tourists at the mercy of flash floods .

The causes of glacier collapse are part of a complex web of interrelated changes to high mountain landscapes due in part to rising global temperatures, say scientists.

Levan Tielidze, research fellow in glacial geomorphology at Australia's Monash University, said the Himalayas are not, as is often imagined, a "frozen and relatively stable environment," but "dynamic systems in which glaciers , snow, permafrost, rock slopes, rivers and monsoon processes interact." 

"As the climate warms, these components are changing simultaneously, meaning hazards can cascade from one process into another," he told DW. When rock, ice and water interact in more unpredictable ways on the world's highest peaks, the resulting debris flows "can transform into a catastrophic flood far downstream."

Almost 25 years ago, in what was then the biggest glacial collapse in history, one glacier crashed onto another in the Caucasus Mountains of North Ossetia in Russia. The event caused avalanches of ice and debris that slid more than 24 kilometers (15 miles) and killed around 125 people.

"The Kolka Glacier disaster was one of the early warnings of the increasing occurrence and potential severity of such glacier-related hazards," said Tielidze. 

Meanwhile, the UN says glaciers in Nepalese mountains have declined by one-third in 30 years, which has added to their instability. 

Some research suggests that even if emissions from burning fossil fuels were low enough to prevent the planet from heating by more than 2 degrees Celsius (3.6 Fahrenheit) compared to pre-industrial times, the wider Hindu Kush Himalayan region could lose up to half its glacier cover — compared to 2020 levels — by the end of the century.

For Dipesh Chapagain, senior scientist at...
body.zh: 气温上升增加了山区发生洪水和雪崩的风险。尼泊尔和西藏的灾难表明迫切需要解决方案以及可以帮助拯救生命的工具。 由于化石燃料的燃烧导致气候变暖并导致降雪量减少，冰河时代形成的高山冰川正在后退并变得不稳定。 这种不稳定性为大片冰川崩塌创造了条件，引发冰雪崩塌，在潮水释放之前可能会堵塞河谷。 8 月 26 日，冰川崩塌在尼泊尔和西藏引发了山地海啸，之后仍有数千人失踪并恐已死亡。与 2025 年摧毁瑞士布拉滕镇的冰川雪崩不同，那次冰川雪崩几乎所有居民都被疏散，喜马拉雅山缺乏预警系统，导致当地人和游客受到山洪暴发的影响。 科学家表示，冰川崩塌的原因是高山景观相互关联的复杂变化网络的一部分，部分原因是全球气温上升。 澳大利亚莫纳什大学冰川地貌学研究员莱万·蒂利泽 (Levan Tielidze) 表示，喜马拉雅山并不像人们通常想象的那样是一个“冰冻且相对稳定的环境”，而是“冰川、积雪、永久冻土、岩坡、河流和季风过程相互作用的动态系统”。 他告诉德国之声：“随着气候变暖，这些组成部分同时发生变化，这意味着危害可能从一个过程级联到另一个过程。” 当岩石、冰和水在世界最高峰上以更难以预测的方式相互作用时，由此产生的泥石流“可能会在下游转化为灾难性的洪水”。 大约 25 年前，俄罗斯北奥塞梯高加索山脉的一座冰川与另一座冰川相撞，发生了当时历史上最严重的冰川崩塌事件。该事件导致冰雪和碎片滑落超过 24 公里（15 英里），造成约 125 人死亡。 蒂利泽说：“科尔卡冰川灾难是此类冰川相关灾害日益频繁且潜在严重性的早期预警之一。” 与此同时，联合国表示，尼泊尔山区的冰川在 30 年内减少了三分之一，这加剧了冰川的不稳定。 一些研究表明，即使燃烧化石燃料的排放量足够低，足以防止地球升温超过工业化前时期 2 摄氏度（3.6 华氏度），到本世纪末，更广阔的兴都库什喜马拉雅地区的冰川覆盖率可能会比 2020 年的水平减少多达一半。 对于 Dipesh Chapagagain 来说，高级科学家......

reflection.en: The melting glaciers and subsequent disasters in Nepal and Tibet are a stark reminder that our planet groans under the weight of human activity. Romans 8:22 speaks of all creation groaning in travail, awaiting its redemption. This passage calls us to acknowledge the deep interconnectedness of our world and our responsibility to care for it.
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏融化的冰川及随之而来的灾难，鲜明地提醒我们，我们的地球在人类活动的重压下呻吟。罗马书8:22说，万物一同叹息劳苦，等候得赎。这段经文呼吁我们认识到我们世界深层的相互联系，以及我们照顾它的责任。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: How China buried Tibet flood images after Nepal disaster
title.zh: 中国如何掩埋了尼泊尔灾难后的西藏洪水图像

summary.en: In Tibet, a digital crackdown followed the deadly flood that has devastated communities along the China-Nepal border. Censors erased viral footage while Chinese state media flooded platforms with official content.
summary.zh: 在西藏，一场致命的洪水摧毁了中国和尼泊尔边境的社区，随后出现了数字审查。审查人员删除了病毒式传播的画面，而中国官方媒体则用官方内容充斥了各大平台。

body.en:
In Tibet, a digital crackdown followed the deadly flood that has devastated communities along the China-Nepal border. Censors erased viral footage while Chinese state media flooded platforms with official content.

When a catastrophic flash flood swept through the rugged China-Nepal border on August 26, the physical devastation was immediate.

In Nepal , a black torrent of mud and rock tore through communities, leaving hundreds dead and thousands more missing along the borderlands.

But across the frontier in Tibet, an autonomous region of China , the physical disaster was almost instantly followed by a digital one: the rapid, high-tech erasure of the catastrophe's visual evidence.

As survivors tried to upload raw footage of the deluge, China's state-backed information control apparatus swung into action, executing a sophisticated, precision operation to shape the public narrative and bury inconvenient truths.

The contrasting realities — a tragic humanitarian crisis in Nepal and a tightly sanitized, triumphant rescue narrative in China — reveal the evolving mechanics of Beijing's modern censorship machine.

Rather than imposing a blunt, blanket blackout, authorities deployed advanced image-recognition technology and "saturated information" tactics to drown out domestic scrutiny while deflecting diplomatic friction abroad.

In the immediate aftermath of the flood-triggered mudslide, local residents captured dramatic footage of the torrent engulfing Gyirong Port, a critical overland trade hub between China and Nepal.

The most striking video showed a black wall of water and debris crashing into and destroying the "national" border gate.

In an article titled "An Unrecorded Mudslide Rushes into Gyirong Port" on China's WeChat, a universal app that combines messaging with payment options and social media functions, local blogger "Matou Qingnian" described the chaotic scene.

"The most terrifying moment happened at the Gyirong Port," the author wrote, describing video footage of crowds, including children, fleeing in panic before a pitch-black torrent swallowed the camera's view.

Within hours, both the article and the raw video footage had vanished from Chinese social media .

According to  China Digital Times (CDT) , an independent watchdog that tracks Chinese internet censorship , the video of the collapsing border gate was systematically blocked from being shared on WeChat, even in private messages.

"The footage itself contained no graphic violence, no protests, and no political slogans," explained Mira, a CDT editor who specializes in tracking sensitive keywords and media. "The target of the censorship was the symbol itself: the National Gate."

Digital analysts note that this censorship highlights a significant upgrade...
body.zh: 在西藏，致命的洪水摧毁了中尼边境沿线的社区，随后进行了数字镇压。审查机构删除了病毒式传播的视频，而中国官方媒体则在平台上充斥着官方内容。 8 月 26 日，一场灾难性的山洪席卷崎岖的中尼边境，造成了立即的破坏。 在尼泊尔，一股黑色泥浆和岩石洪流席卷了边境地区的社区，造成数百人死亡、数千人失踪。 但在中国西藏自治区的边境地区，这场物理灾难几乎立刻就发生了一场数字灾难：灾难的视觉证据被迅速、高科技删除。 当幸存者试图上传洪水的原始镜头时，中国国家支持的信息控制机构立即采取行动，执行复杂而精确的操作，以塑造公众叙事并掩盖难以忽视的真相。 对比鲜明的现实——尼泊尔悲惨的人道主义危机和中国严密消毒、胜利的救援故事——揭示了北京现代审查机制不断演变的机制。 当局没有实施生硬、全面的封锁，而是采用了先进的图像识别技术和“饱和信息”策略来淹没国内审查，同时转移国外的外交摩擦。 洪水引发的泥石流发生后，当地居民拍下了洪流吞没吉隆港的戏剧性镜头，吉隆港是中国和尼泊尔之间重要的陆路贸易枢纽。 最引人注目的视频显示，黑色的水墙和碎片冲撞并摧毁了“国家”边境大门。 当地博主“马头青年”在中国微信（一款将消息传递、支付选项和社交媒体功能结合在一起的通用应用程序）上发表了一篇题为“一场未记录的泥石流冲进吉隆口岸”的文章，描述了当时的混乱场面。 “最可怕的时刻发生在吉隆口岸，”作者写道，并描述了包括儿童在内的人群在漆黑的洪流吞没摄像机视野之前惊慌失措的画面。 几个小时内，这篇文章和原始视频片段就从中国社交媒体上消失了。 据追踪中国互联网审查制度的独立监管机构中国数字时代（CDT）称，倒塌边境大门的视频被系统性地禁止在微信上分享，甚至在私人信息中也是如此。 专门跟踪敏感关键词和媒体的 CDT 编辑米拉解释说：“视频本身不包含暴力画面、抗议活动和政治口号。” “审查的目标是标志本身：国门。” 数字分析师指出，这次审查凸显了重大升级......

reflection.en: The story describes how visual evidence of a devastating flood in Tibet was systematically erased, replaced by official narratives. This act of censorship raises questions about truth and transparency, reminding us of the importance of speaking truthfully and avoiding deception, as Ephesians 4:25 urges.
reflection.zh: 故事描述了西藏一场毁灭性洪水的视觉证据如何被系统性地抹去，并被官方叙事所取代。这种审查行为引发了关于真相和透明度的疑问，提醒我们说实话和避免欺骗的重要性，正如以弗所书4:25所敦促的那样。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: The problem Albanese will have to solve to win friends in New York
title.zh: Albanese将在纽约赢得友谊的问题

summary.en: The Australian government has supported the expansion of two new coal and gas projects amidst crucial climate change talks. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese's efforts to strengthen Pacific ties and influence the world at the United Nations could be compromised by Australia's failure to meet climate change commitments,...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚政府在关键的气候变化谈判中支持了两个新的煤炭和天然气项目的扩张。批评人士警告说，总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯加强太平洋联系并影响联合国的努力可能会因澳大利亚未能履行气候变化承诺而受到损害。

body.en:
Prime Minister Anthony Albanese's efforts to strengthen Pacific ties and influence the world at the United Nations could be compromised by Australia's failure to meet climate change commitments, critics have warned.

Albanese attended the Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) in Palau this week, preparing for an Australian-organised climate meeting to be held in Fiji and Tuvalu next month.

The event will take place ahead of the United Nations' climate change conference, COP31, which will be held in Antalya, Türkiye in November.

The meeting, an outcome of Australia's failed bid to host COP31 , will include representatives from Antigua and Barbuda, Cabo Verde, Thailand, Maldives, Timor-Leste, Germany, Mexico and South Korea — and focus on the realities of climate change for the Pacific Islands.

During a press conference in Palau this week, Albanese was questioned about the value of the pre-COP31 event, given the low attendance among non-Pacific Islander leaders.

He accused the journalist of being "so disrespectful" to Pacific leaders present.

"It's about bringing Pacific frontline experience to the centre of global deliberations," he said.

"We need to actually have some respect for the process and respect for our Pacific leaders — and Australia has an absolute interest in engaging with the Pacific."

Albanese's attendance at this year's PIF is the start of a string of international events on his calendar, including the UN General Assembly in New York.

Albanese will address the UNGA on 24 September in a bid to secure a non-permanent place on the UN Security Council in 2029-30.

"A seat on the Security Council would give Australia a stronger voice in the decisions that affect our region," Foreign Minister Penny Wong said.

Wesley Morgan, Australian Climate Council fellow and senior research associate at the UNSW's Institute of Climate Risk and Response, said climate change is the "single greatest threat" to the Pacific Islands.

"When it was first raised at the UN Security Council 20 years ago, Pacific countries said climate change is what guns and bombs are to other nations," Morgan said.

He said the key to Australia becoming the region's "security partner of choice" is proper action on climate change.

In 2022, Solomon Islands signed a security deal with China — an act that got "alarm bells ringing in Canberra", Morgan said.

This was the catalyst for Australia signing bilateral agreements with Tuvalu, Naoero, Papua New Guinea, Vanuatu and Fiji.

body.zh: 批评人士警告说，澳大利亚未能履行气候变化承诺，可能会损害澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞在联合国加强太平洋关系和影响世界的努力。 阿尔巴尼斯本周出席了在帕劳举行的太平洋岛屿论坛（PIF），为下个月在斐济和图瓦卢举行的澳大利亚组织的气候会议做准备。 该活动将在联合国气候变化大会 COP31 之前举行，该会议将于 11 月在土耳其安塔利亚举行。 这次会议是澳大利亚申办 COP31 失败的结果，会议将包括来自安提瓜和巴布达、佛得角、泰国、马尔代夫、东帝汶、德国、墨西哥和韩国的代表，重点讨论太平洋岛屿气候变化的现实。 本周在帕劳举行的新闻发布会上，鉴于非太平洋岛民领导人出席率较低，Albanese 被问及 COP31 前活动的价值。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他指责这名记者对在场的太平洋领导人“非常不尊重”。 “这是为了将太平洋前线的经验带到全球审议的中心，”他说。 “我们实际上需要尊重这一进程，尊重我们的太平洋领导人——澳大利亚对与太平洋地区的接触有着绝对的兴趣。” Albanese 出席今年的 PIF 是他日程上一系列国际活动的开始，其中包括在纽约举行的联合国大会。 阿尔巴内塞将于 9 月 24 日在联合国大会上发表讲话，争取在 2029-30 年度获得联合国安理会非常任理事国席位。 外交部长黄英贤表示：“在安理会获得席位将使澳大利亚在影响我们地区的决策中拥有更强的发言权。” 澳大利亚气候委员会研究员、新南威尔士大学气候风险与应对研究所高级研究员韦斯利·摩根表示，气候变化是太平洋岛屿面临的“最大威胁”。 “20年前，当太平洋国家首次在联合国安理会提出这一问题时，太平洋国家表示，气候变化对于其他国家来说就像枪支和炸弹一样，”摩根说。 他表示，澳大利亚成为该地区“首选安全伙伴”的关键是对气候变化采取适当行动。 摩根表示，2022 年，所罗门群岛与中国签署了一项安全协议，这一行为“给堪培拉敲响了警钟”。 这是澳大利亚与图瓦卢、纳奥罗、巴布亚新几内亚、瓦努阿图和斐济签署双边协议的催化剂。 他说，阻止澳大利亚履行这些协议的原因是它是世界上最大的煤炭和天然气出口国之一，而且出口......

title.en: Why the 'great Aussie summer' may become a thing of the past
title.zh: 为什么“伟大的澳大利亚夏天”可能成为过去

summary.en: Should we schedule our 'peak' summer — holidays, school breaks and sporting events — according to safety rather than tradition? Last summer, Paris Brooke watched in horror as a bushfire blazed through the national park across the lake from her township of Mallacoota in north-east Victoria. The exodus was reminiscent...
summary.zh: 我们是否应该根据安全而不是传统来安排我们的“高峰”夏季——假期、学校休息和体育赛事？去年夏天，巴黎·布鲁克惊恐地看着一场丛林大火在她家乡维多利亚州东北部马拉库塔镇对面的湖泊上燃烧。这次撤离让人想起 2019-20 年夏天，澳大利亚的“黑色夏天”丛林大火席卷并摧毁了这个海滨小镇。马拉库塔是受灾最严重的地区之一。

body.en:
Last summer, Paris Brooke watched in horror as a bushfire blazed through the national park across the lake from her township of Mallacoota in north-east Victoria.

"The camp park emptied out overnight, leaving businesses that depend on summer tourism stuck with unused supplies and staff, but no more tourists," Brooke tells SBS News.

The exodus was reminiscent of the summer of 2019-20, when Australia's Black Summer bushfires swept through and devastated the beachside town.

Mallacoota was among the hardest-hit areas . Apocalyptic-looking scenes of residents and holidaymakers sheltering in boats off the coast, under a red sky thick with smoke, were broadcast around the world.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

While Brooke hasn't necessarily seen a slowdown in holidaymakers to the town since, she believes stays are shortening and worries the increased likelihood of extreme weather will hit summer trade long-term.

It's why she set up the Wilderness Collective, a community not-for-profit aimed at helping locals build new skills and businesses to reduce reliance on summer tourism.

"People are much more aware of natural disasters such as bushfires or droughts," she says.

On the same day last summer, climate scientist Linden Ashcroft was on the beach in Mallacoota. She recalls her kids playing in the water as embers and burnt leaves fell around them.

"It was pretty heartbreaking and terrifying. Everyone was really creeped out, and the town was covered in smoke," she says.

It left her with a lasting sense of cognitive dissonance — this is not how summer is supposed to feel.

That feeling is now rippling around the country, reaching far beyond places like Mallacoota that are historically prone to bushfires.

"Black Summer 2019–2020 was a real step change; it made people face the reality that summer can't just be carefree anymore," Ashcroft says.

Climate Council director and academic Lesley Hughes says the changing climate is reshaping Australians' notion of summer: instead of looking forward to it, people increasingly feel apprehensive.

"They dread the heatwaves, the bushfires, not being able to do the things they used to. Climate change is stealing the part of the year Australians looked forward to most."

With higher temperatures and more extreme weather events becoming a fixture of the holiday season in parts of the country, could this signal the end of 'great Aussie summer'?

Australia is now 1.5C warmer on average than it was a century ago, according to the National Climate Risk Assessment. It's driving more extreme heatwaves and dangerous fire weather.

Monash climate scientist Andrew Watkins, former head of the Bureau of...
body.zh: 去年夏天，帕丽斯·布鲁克惊恐地看到一场丛林大火席卷了维多利亚州东北部马拉库塔镇与湖对岸的国家公园。 布鲁克告诉 SBS 新闻：“营地公园一夜之间就空了，依赖夏季旅游业的企业陷入了闲置的物资和员工困境，但没有更多的游客。” 这种逃亡让人想起2019-20年夏天，当时澳大利亚的黑夏丛林大火席卷并摧毁了这座海滨小镇。 马拉库塔是受灾最严重的地区之一。世界各地都在播放着世界末日般的场景，居民和度假者在浓烟滚滚的红色天空下，在海岸附近的船上避难。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 虽然布鲁克此后并没有看到到该镇度假的人数有所减少，但她认为停留时间正在缩短，并担心极端天气可能性的增加将长期影响夏季贸易。 这就是为什么她成立了 Wilderness Collective，这是一个非营利性社区，旨在帮助当地人培养新技能和开展业务，以减少对夏季旅游的依赖。 “人们对森林大火或干旱等自然灾害有了更多的认识，”她说。 去年夏天的同一天，气候科学家林登·阿什克罗夫特在马拉库塔的海滩上。她回忆起孩子们在水里玩耍时，余烬和烧焦的树叶落在他们周围。 “这真是令人心碎和可怕。每个人都吓坏了，整个城镇都笼罩在烟雾中，”她说。 这给她留下了一种持久的认知失调感——这不是夏天应该有的感觉。 这种感觉现在正在全国蔓延，远远超出了像马拉库塔这样历史上容易发生丛林大火的地方。 阿什克罗夫特说：“2019-2020 年的黑色夏天是一个真正的转变；它让人们面对现实，夏天不能再无忧无虑了。” 气候委员会主任兼学者莱斯利·休斯表示，气候变化正在重塑澳大利亚人对夏季的看法：人们不再期待夏季，而是越来越感到担忧。 “他们害怕热浪、丛林大火，无法做以前做的事情。气候变化正在抢走澳大利亚人一年中最期待的部分。” 随着更高的气温和更多的极端天气事件成为该国部分地区假期的固定内容，这是否标志着“伟大的澳大利亚夏季”的结束？ 根据国家气候风险评估，澳大利亚现在的平均气温比一个世纪前高 1.5 摄氏度。它正在引发更加极端的热浪和危险的火灾天气。 莫纳什气候科学家安德鲁·沃特金斯 (Andrew Watkins)，前气象局局长...

reflection.en: The Australian summer, a time of tradition and celebration, is increasingly threatened by the harsh realities of climate change. The fires described in Mallacoota are not just isolated incidents but symptoms of a larger distress, a 'groaning' of creation as described in Romans 8:22. As we face these disruptions, may we seek wisdom to adapt our traditions...
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚的夏天，一个充满传统和庆祝的季节，正日益受到气候变化严峻现实的威胁。马拉库塔所描述的火灾不仅仅是孤立的事件，更是更大痛苦的征兆，正如罗马书 8:22 所述，是受造之物的“叹息”。当我们面对这些干扰时，愿我们寻求智慧来调整我们的传统，并照管托付给我们的土地。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: ‘Sisyphus would be proud’: Queensland tribunal orders repairs to pool that doesn’t exist
title.zh: “西西弗斯会为此感到骄傲”：昆士兰法庭下令修复一个不存在的泳池

summary.en: A Queensland tribunal has ordered a company to repair a swimming pool that no longer exists, only to immediately stay its own order, deeming the repairs 'impossible' to carry out. The tribunal compared the situation to the Greek myth of Sisyphus, who was condemned to eternally roll a boulder uphill.
summary.zh: 昆士兰一个法庭命令一家公司修复一个已不存在的游泳池，但随后立即搁置了自己的命令，认为修复工作“不可能”完成。法庭将此情境比作希腊神话中西西弗斯永恒地将巨石推上山顶的命运。

body.en:
In an act it compared to the ancient Greek myth of a man forced to roll a rock up a hill forever, a Queensland tribunal has ordered a company to make repair works on a pool that no longer exists.

Peter Roney KC, a member of the Queensland Civil and Administrative Tribunal, handed down a judgment in the case this week.

“I have been called upon to decide many outcomes in some strange and unusual circumstances whilst a member of this tribunal, but this case has its own special place,” Roney wrote.

The case was a challenge brought by the building firm Abel Gaspi Apolonia against what the tribunal said was an “almost incomprehensible” direction by the Queensland Building and Construction Commission relating to work done on a pool in Capalaba in 2021.

Part of the pool’s coping – a finish installed around the edges to stop leaking and prevent swimmers slipping – had had not been installed correctly and had sustained damage after heavy rain, the tribunal heard.

According to the judgment, the commission in 2024 directed the company that because “the installation of the copping (sic) has not been installed in an expected competent tradesman like manner” that “the non-structural defect falls Within 12 months of practical completion”.

But the tribunal said it was difficult to understand what work the commission wanted done and what the defect was.

The tribunal also said there was an even more fundamental problem: the pool had been removed in the meantime.

“After several hours of a hearing being conducted, using the resources of this state to determine what seemed to be an issue designed to protect a homeowner who had contracted for work on her pool, it was discovered, but only when the Commission checked, that the pool had ceased to exist for some years, and that the directive could not be given effect to in any way,” the judgment reads.

A lawyer acting for the QBCC submitted that the tribunal should still make a judgment, on the basis that it would be recorded on the builder’s licence history.

“To expect the resources of this state to be committed to making findings about the appropriateness of decision-making years earlier, in which has little or no practical significance, might be seen by many as a waste of public resources,” it reads.

“To decide the case anyway becomes an almost academic exercise. I will do so anyway. Sisyphus would be proud.”

The company argued that the pool was already old and defective before it was commissioned to work on it, that it made repairs that it had not been paid for and that the damage was caused by “excessive rainfall, soil movement, and the natural aging of the pool structure” rather than poor workmanship.

The tribunal ruled that the company had not repaired the coping as it said, and ordered that it rectify its...
body.zh: 昆士兰法庭下令一家公司对一个不复存在的水池进行修复工作，这一行为类似于古希腊神话中的一个人被迫将一块岩石永远滚上山的故事。 昆士兰民事和行政法庭成员 Peter Roney KC 本周对此案作出了判决。 罗尼写道：“作为该法庭的成员，我被要求在一些奇怪和不寻常的情况下决定许多结果，但这个案件有其特殊的地位。” 该案是建筑公司 Abel Gaspi Apolonia 对昆士兰州建筑和建设委员会关于 2021 年卡帕拉巴泳池工程的指示提出的质疑，仲裁庭称该指示“几乎难以理解”。 法庭获悉，游泳池顶部的一部分——在边缘安装的一个饰面，以防止渗漏并防止游泳者滑倒——安装不正确，在大雨后遭受了损坏。 根据判决，委员会在 2024 年指示该公司，由于“顶部（原文如此）的安装并未按照预期的合格技工方式进行安装”，“非结构性缺陷将在实际完成后的 12 个月内发生”。 但仲裁庭表示，很难理解委员会想要完成哪些工作以及缺陷是什么。 法庭还表示，还有一个更根本的问题：游泳池同时被拆除。 判决书写道：“经过几个小时的听证会，利用本州的资源来确定一个似乎旨在保护在其泳池上承包工程的房主的问题，但只有在委员会检查后才发现，该泳池已不复存在多年，并且该指令无法以任何方式生效。” QBCC 的一名代理律师表示，仲裁庭仍应做出判决，因为该判决将记录在建筑商的许可证历史中。 报告写道：“期望该州的资源致力于早些年就决策的适当性进行调查，而这几乎没有或根本没有实际意义，可能被许多人视为浪费公共资源。” “无论如何，决定这个案子几乎成了一项学术活动。无论如何我都会这样做。西西弗斯会感到自豪。” 该公司辩称，该泳池在委托维修之前就已经陈旧且有缺陷，并且进行了未付款的维修，并且损坏是由“过量降雨、土壤移动和泳池结构自然老化”造成的，而不是由于工艺不良造成的。 仲裁庭裁定该公司没有按照其所说修复顶部，并责令其纠正......

reflection.en: The Queensland Civil and Administrative Tribunal found itself in a peculiar bind, ordering repairs on a non-existent pool and then admitting the task was impossible. This echoes the prophet Habakkuk's lament over a justice system that seemed broken and ineffective, where the law itself was perverted. It reminds us to pray for wisdom and integrity in all our...
reflection.zh: 昆士兰民事和行政法庭发现自己陷入了一个奇怪的困境，命令修复一个不存在的泳池，然后承认这项任务是不可能的。这呼应了先知哈巴谷对一个似乎破碎且无效的司法系统的哀叹，在那里法律本身被扭曲了。它提醒我们要为所有机构的智慧和正直祈祷，使它们能够服务于真正的正义，而不是沦为荒诞的闹剧。

verse.textEn: The law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
verse.textZh: 因此律法放松，公理也不显明；恶人围困义人，所以公理显然颠倒。

title.en: El Niño is already wreaking havoc around the world — and it's only getting started
title.zh: 厄尔尼诺已在全球造成破坏——而这仅仅是开始

summary.en: The strengthening El Niño is already disrupting lives around the world, as the United Nations warns the "surging" climate pattern is raising the risk of months of heatwaves, floods, drought and extreme weather. The World Meteorological Organization (WMO) stated there is a "nearly 100 per cent" likelihood that El Niño...
summary.zh: 正在加强的厄尔尼诺现象已在全球范围内扰乱人们的生活，联合国警告称，这一“汹涌”的气候模式增加了未来数月出现热浪、洪水、干旱和极端天气的风险。世界气象组织（WMO）表示，厄尔尼诺现象“几乎有100%的可能性”将持续到明年二月，这是有史以来首次如此明确的厄尔尼诺更新。世界气象组织秘书长塞莱斯特·绍洛指出，自今年六月正式宣布...

body.en:
The strengthening El Niño is already disrupting lives around the world, as the United Nations warns the "surging" climate pattern is raising the risk of months of heatwaves, floods, drought and extreme weather.

On Thursday, the World Meteorological Organization (WMO) said there was a likelihood of "nearly 100 per cent" that El Niño will persist through to February, noting that this was the first time that an El Niño update had been so unequivocal.

The WMO's secretary-general, Celeste Saulo, said the climate driver, which was officially declared underway in June, has already dealt a blow to communities worldwide.

"We are already seeing disruption and devastation from droughts and floods and we expect these impacts to increase as El Niño intensifies," she said.

The phenomenon is expected to peak at very high intensity towards the end of the year — potentially at a record-breaking level — with lasting effects on the climate well into 2027 and the prospect of unprecedented global heat.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

UN secretary-general António Guterres warned that El Niño is "being supersized before our eyes" by climate change.

"The science leaves no room for doubt: the planet is in uncharted waters, and those waters are heating up," Guterres said in response to the WMO update.

El Niño is associated with higher global temperatures and can bring drought and extreme heat to some regions while increasing rainfall and flood risks in others.

In Australia, El Niño typically increases the likelihood of hotter, drier conditions in the east and south-east, though its influence varies, and other climate factors also shape rainfall and temperatures.

Warmer-than-usual weather is expected across most of Australia through the spring.

More than a million students are learning remotely this week as toxic wildfire haze blankets parts of Indonesia, with officials warning that efforts to extinguish the blazes are entering a critical phase.

"Our problems are not over. September is the peak of El Niño," Indonesia's forestry minister Raja Juli Antoni told reporters this week.

El Niño is driving hotter, drier conditions in the region, intensifying a dry season that has seen thousands of hectares burnt.

Indonesian forest fire forensics expert Bambang Hero Saharjo told the BBC this year's El Niño-fuelled blazes could burn an area as large as 11 million hectares.

The haze has spread across parts of Southeast Asia, triggering health warnings and hospitalisations.

The health ministry in neighbouring Malaysia has reported rising cases of asthma and conjunctivitis nationwide as air quality...
body.zh: 不断加强的厄尔尼诺现象已经扰乱了世界各地的生活，联合国警告称，这种“急剧上升”的气候模式正在增加持续数月的热浪、洪水、干旱和极端天气的风险。 周四，世界气象组织（WMO）表示，厄尔尼诺现象有“近100%”的可能性将持续到二月份，并指出这是第一次如此明确地更新厄尔尼诺现象。 世界气象组织秘书长塞莱斯特·索洛 (Celeste Saulo) 表示，6 月份正式宣布启动的气候驱动计划已经对世界各地的社区造成了打击。 她说：“我们已经看到干旱和洪水造成的破坏和破坏，预计随着厄尔尼诺现象的加剧，这些影响将会加剧。” 预计这种现象将在年底达到非常高的强度——可能达到破纪录的水平——对气候的持续影响将持续到 2027 年，全球可能会出现前所未有的高温。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯警告说，气候变化导致厄尔尼诺现象“在我们眼前变得更加严重”。 古特雷斯在回应世界气象组织的最新消息时表示：“科学不容置疑：地球正处于未知水域，而且这些水域正在升温。” 厄尔尼诺现象与全球气温升高有关，可能给一些地区带来干旱和极端高温，同时增加其他地区的降雨和洪水风险。 在澳大利亚，厄尔尼诺现象通常会增加东部和东南部出现更热、更干燥天气的可能性，尽管其影响各不相同，而且其他气候因素也会影响降雨量和气温。 预计整个春季澳大利亚大部分地区的天气将比平常温暖。 本周，有毒野火烟雾笼罩印度尼西亚部分地区，超过一百万学生正在远程学习，官员警告说，扑灭大火的努力正进入关键阶段。 “我们的问题还没有结束。九月是厄尔尼诺现象的顶峰，”印度尼西亚林业部长拉贾·朱利·安东尼本周告诉记者。 厄尔尼诺现象导致该地区气候变得更加炎热、干燥，加剧了旱季，导致数千公顷土地被烧毁。 印度尼西亚森林火灾法医专家 Bambang Hero Saharjo 告诉 BBC，今年厄尔尼诺现象引发的大火可能会烧毁面积达 1100 万公顷的土地。 雾霾已经蔓延到东南亚部分地区，引发健康警告和住院治疗。 邻国马来西亚卫生部报告称，由于空气质量问题，全国哮喘和结膜炎病例不断增加……

reflection.en: The world's climate system, like all of creation, groans under the weight of forces beyond its immediate control. The "disruption and devastation" wrought by El Niño serves as a stark reminder of our planet's vulnerability and interconnectedness. In these times of extreme weather, we are called to lament the brokenness we witness and to seek wisdom in...
reflection.zh: 世界的气候系统，如同所有被造物一样，在无法掌控的力量重压下发出呻吟。厄尔尼诺现象所带来的“混乱和毁灭”是地球脆弱性和相互关联性的一个严峻警示。在这些极端天气频发的时刻，我们被呼召为所见的破碎而哀恸，并在照管受托于我们的地球时寻求智慧。

title.en: This virus has evolved. Australia doesn't have a new vaccine
title.zh: 这种病毒已经进化。澳大利亚没有新疫苗

summary.en: Australia is lagging behind the latest formulations being developed overseas.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚在采用海外最新疫苗配方方面滞后。

body.en:
Australians can't yet access a COVID-19 vaccine tailored for new variants, highlighting how Australia's system tends to lag behind, as a major manufacturer confirms it has no plans to push into Australia's market.

Pfizer and BioNTech's latest COVID-19 vaccine, adapted to target the XFG subvariant, has been approved in the United States for the 2026-27 season, following international guidance to more closely match vaccines with contemporary circulating variants.

But experts say the lag is not necessarily cause for alarm, with Australia continuing to monitor circulating variants and having access to relatively recent updated vaccines.

Pfizer and BioNTech's LP.8.1-adapted COVID-19 vaccine was registered on the Australian Register of Therapeutic Goods in late 2025 and became available in Australia in December.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The issue is therefore less about Australia going without updated COVID-19 vaccines, and more about how quickly newer formulations can be made available as the virus continues to evolve.

Professor Paul Griffin, an infectious diseases physician and clinical microbiologist, said Australia tended to lag behind some countries in updating COVID-19 vaccines.

"I think it's just some of the way we're managing those updates just means it's not quite happening as streamlined a way as we might like," he said.

Griffin said countries with more established frameworks could update vaccines closer to real time.

While he said faster access would be preferable, he also stressed the importance of continuing to update vaccines as the virus changes.

But Sarah McGuinness, a senior research fellow at Monash University, told SBS News there was no single explanation for why a new formulation might become available overseas before it does in Australia.

She said one factor is the decisions vaccine manufacturers make about which countries to seek regulatory approval in, and when, with vaccine sponsors responsible for deciding whether to seek regulatory approval in different countries.

McGuinness also said Australia is a relatively small market compared with areas such as the US and Europe, meaning new formulations are not always brought here first.

Peter Markey, a GP and public health physician who chairs the Royal Australian College of General Practitioners' public health special interest group, said Australian authorities were continuing to monitor the virus internationally.

He said governments, researchers and the World Health Organization would be watching circulating strains and sub-strains and "looking out for vaccines to match them".

title.en: Before global fame, Steve Irwin was a wildlife researcher with a tatty green backpack
title.zh: 环球成名之前，史蒂夫·欧文是一位带着破旧绿色背包的野生动物研究员

summary.en: Twenty years after his death, Steve Irwin's passion for wildlife lives on through his family and the generations he inspired.
summary.zh: 在他去世二十年后，史蒂夫·欧文对野生动物的热情通过他的家人和他激励的几代人得以延续。

body.en:
Twenty years after Steve Irwin's sudden death, a man who wrestled crocodiles with him for a living still can't talk about it without choking up.

In 2006, while holidaying in France, Mark Read had just returned from a walk with his baby daughter when he found his wife sobbing outside an internet café.

Two decades on, the memories of the man the world knew as the Crocodile Hunter still bring a lump to his throat.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Read first met Irwin in 1997 on what can only be described as a very Steve Irwin kind of operation, a turtle rodeo in Queensland's Moreton Bay.

People were tearing around in small, fast boats in shallow water, hurling themselves overboard to wrestle the surprised critters to the surface in order to study their health, breeding status and growth rates.

From that chaotic first encounter, the pair went on to spend years working together on crocodile research across north Queensland.

Their collaboration helped launch a pioneering satellite‑tracking effort dubbed Crocs in Space, a partnership between the Queensland Parks and Wildlife Service, Australia Zoo and the University of Queensland.

It used some of the first functional satellite transmitters ever fitted to estuarine crocodiles, revealing how far the big predators could roam and even how many found their way home after relocation.

Far from a caricature, Read remembers Irwin as an extraordinarily intelligent, relentlessly curious collaborator in the field.

Inside was an even tattier folder and notepad he constantly filled with sketches to capture techniques and ideas for future research.

There were long, quiet hours that never made it to television — nights around campfires and early mornings when Irwin would wake Read for tea and conversations about crocodiles, wild places and how to get the public to care.

For a man with global reach and serious earning power, Irwin never changed, turning up to remote field trips in boots with holes patched up with gaffer tape.

"It most certainly wasn't about earning a heap of money and living a lavish lifestyle."

It was in the way he could read a crocodile's body language in a heartbeat or calmly scoop up a six‑foot coastal taipan snake from the grass, keep it unruffled, and then let it slide away as if it were the most natural thing in the world.

He was, Read says, both a "proper stirrer" who loved teasing people in good humour and a deeply tender family man who "lived for his family".

When Steve and Terri Irwin's first daughter was born, they sent boxes of presents and an enormous floral arrangement to the family home.

When the Reads visited Australia Zoo with the baby, Irwin...
body.zh: 史蒂夫·欧文突然去世二十年后，一个以与他搏斗鳄鱼为生的人仍然无法不哽咽地谈论这件事。 2006年，马克·里德在法国度假时，刚带着小女儿散步回来，就发现妻子在网吧外哭泣。 二十年过去了，这位举世闻名的鳄鱼猎人的记忆仍然让他哽咽。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 里德第一次见到欧文是在 1997 年，当时他正在昆士兰州莫顿湾举办一场海龟竞技表演，这只能说是一种非常史蒂夫·欧文 (Steve Irwin) 风格的活动。 人们乘坐又小又快的船在浅水中划来划去，把自己从船上扔到海里，把这些受到惊吓的生物摔到水面，以研究它们的健康状况、繁殖状况和生长速度。 从那次混乱的第一次相遇开始，两人一起花了数年时间在昆士兰北部进行鳄鱼研究。 他们的合作帮助启动了一项名为 Crocs in Space 的开创性卫星追踪项目，该项目是昆士兰公园和野生动物服务中心、澳大利亚动物园和昆士兰大学之间的合作伙伴关系。 它使用了一些首次安装在河口鳄鱼身上的功能性卫星发射器，揭示了大型掠食者可以漫游多远，甚至有多少在搬迁后找到了回家的路。 里德记忆中的欧文远非漫画人物，他是该领域一位非常聪明、充满好奇心的合作者。 里面是一个更破烂的文件夹和记事本，他不断地写满草图，以捕捉未来研究的技术和想法。 漫长而安静的时光从未出现在电视上——夜晚篝火旁，清晨，欧文会起床喝茶，谈论鳄鱼、野生动物以及如何让公众关心。 对于一个具有全球影响力和强大赚钱能力的人来说，欧文从未改变，他穿着用胶带修补破洞的靴子参加远程实地考察。 “这肯定不是为了赚大钱并过奢侈的生活方式。” 就像他能瞬间读懂鳄鱼的肢体语言，或者平静地从草丛中舀起一条六英尺长的沿海太攀蛇，让它保持平静，然后让它溜走，就好像这是世界上最自然的事情一样。 里德说，他既是一个“适当的搅局者”，喜欢以幽默的方式取笑别人，又是一个“为家人而活”的温柔的顾家男人。 当史蒂夫·欧文和特丽·欧文的第一个女儿出生时，他们向家里寄去了一盒盒礼物和一束巨大的插花。 当里兹一家带着孩子参观澳大利亚动物园时，欧文……

His deep connection with animals, from crocodiles to turtles, showcased a profound appreciation for creation. The Bible teaches that the heavens and earth declare their Creator's glory, and Irwin's work embodied this, revealing the divine through the vibrant life he...

When "intentional unlawful conduct" leads to breaches in practice, as found at this Hong Kong clinic, it underscores the critical need for integrity and accountability in all professions. We are called to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with Yahweh, ensuring that even...
reflection.zh: 通过辅助生殖技术追求生命，承载着深远的伦理责任。当“故意违法行为”导致违规操作时，正如香港这家诊所的事件所揭示的，这凸显了所有行业对诚信和问责制的迫切需求。我们被呼召要秉持公义，喜爱怜悯，谦卑地与雅伟同行，确保即使在复杂的医疗领域，伦理标准也能维护所有相关人员的尊严。

title.en: Health Dept concludes embryo mix-up probe
title.zh: 卫生署完成胚胎混淆调查

summary.en: The Department of Health has concluded its investigation into a fertility clinic in Central after embryo samples sent for genetic testing were found not to match the intended parents' DNA. The clinic, Heal Fertility Limited, failed to report the error within the mandatory timeframe, leading to an investigation and...
summary.zh: 卫生署已完成对中环一家生育诊所的调查，此前送往基因检测的胚胎样本被发现与预期父母的DNA不符。该诊所Heal Fertility Limited未能按规定时限报告此错误，导致了调查和临时措施，包括暂停接收新病例。

body.en: The Department of Health said it has concluded its investigation into a fertility clinic in Central following an incident in which embryo samples sent for genetic testing were found not to match the DNA of the intended parents. The breach came to light in early July when Heal Fertility Limited failed to report the error to the department within the mandatory time frame. Health officials then ordered management to submit an investigation report within four weeks. As an interim enforcement measure, the clinic was instructed to stop accepting new reproductive technology cases and to make appropriate arrangements for its existing patients. On July 7, the Council on Human Reproductive Technology suspended 14 of the clinic’s 17 licensed treatment services, permitting only three services related to the storage of gametes or embryos to continue during the probe. The Department of Health said it received the investigation report on July 29, outlining both short-term corrective actions and long-term procedural reforms. These included revisions to the handling and storage protocols for embryos and biopsy specimens. Following its review, the department determined that the clinic had been non-compliant with the Code of Practice concerning the timely reporting of Serious Untoward Events. Health officials have since issued formal regulatory requirements, reiterating that all such incidents must be reported within 24 hours of identification. The department said the clinic has updated its internal procedures and reporting forms to align with these standards, and that officials will continue to monitor the effectiveness of these changes. In a separate development, the Council on Human Reproductive Technology held a special meeting on Thursday to review findings from its Investigation Committee and consider issues related to the clinic’s operating licence. The council has directed the clinic to adopt further remedial measures. Until a final decision on the licence is made, the clinic will remain restricted to offering only its three storage services for gametes or embryos. Meanwhile, police are investigating whether the incident involved intentional unlawful conduct. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 卫生部表示，在发生一起送去基因检测的胚胎样本与准父母 DNA 不匹配的事件后，已结束对中环一家生育诊所的调查。该漏洞于 7 月初曝光，当时 Heal Fertility Limited 未能在规定的时间内向该部门报告错误。卫生官员随后命令管理层在四个星期内提交调查报告。作为临时执法措施，该诊所被指示停止接受新的生殖技术案件，并为现有患者做出适当安排。 7 月 7 日，人类生殖技术委员会暂停了该诊所 17 项许可治疗服务中的 14 项，只允许在调查期间继续提供与配子或胚胎储存相关的 3 项服务。卫生部表示，它于 7 月 29 日收到调查报告，概述了短期纠正措施和长期程序改革。其中包括对胚胎和活检标本的处理和储存协议的修订。经过审查，该部门确定该诊所没有遵守有关及时报告严重不良事件的业务守则。此后，卫生官员发布了正式监管要求，重申所有此类事件必须在确诊后 24 小时内报告。该部门表示，该诊所已更新其内部程序和报告表格，以符合这些标准，官员将继续监测这些变化的有效性。另一项进展是，人类生殖技术委员会于周四举行了一次特别会议，审查其调查委员会的调查结果，并考虑与诊所经营许可证相关的问题。委员会已指示诊所采取进一步的补救措施。在做出许可的最终决定之前，该诊所将仍然仅限于提供配子或胚胎的三种存储服务。同时，警方正在调查该事件是否涉及故意违法行为。埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: This news highlights a serious breach of trust and protocol in a field deeply connected to the creation of new life. The incident involving misidentified embryos serves as a stark reminder of the vulnerability and preciousness of human life at its earliest stages. May we always approach such sensitive matters with the utmost care and integrity, recognizing...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻揭示了在一个与孕育新生命息息相关的领域中，发生了严重的信任和规程失误。这起涉及胚胎身份错误的事件，令人警醒地提醒我们人类生命在最初阶段的脆弱与宝贵。愿我们永远以最大的谨慎和诚信来处理这些敏感事务，认识到每一个生命都是一份恩赐。

title.en: Hong Kong to consider historic grade status for popular Kennedy Town seaside photo spot
title.zh: 香港考虑将热门的西环海滨拍照景点列为历史建筑

summary.en: Hong Kong is considering granting historic grade status to a picturesque seaside spot along the Kennedy Town waterfront, which has become very popular with mainland tourists. The seawall in New Praya, Kennedy Town, is being evaluated for Grade 2 status by the Antiquities Advisory Board, recognizing its over a century...
summary.zh: 香港正考虑将位于西环海滨的一个风景如画的海滨景点列为历史建筑，该景点已成为内地游客的热门打卡地。西环海旁的海堤正由古物咨询委员会评估是否列为二级历史建筑，该海堤已有百年历史。

body.en: Hong Kong is considering granting historic grade status to a picturesque seaside spot along the Kennedy Town waterfront that has surged in popularity among mainland tourists. People line up to take a photo outside a coffee shop near the Kennedy Town Praya, on August 15, 2023. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. According to a memorandum from the Antiquities and Monuments Office, the seawall in New Praya, Kennedy Town, is being considered for Grade 2 status. The Antiquities Advisory Board will meet to discuss the matter on Thursday next week. The seawall, which is not visible from the street, boasts over a century of history. Hong Kong’s historic buildings are classified into three grades, with Grade 1 denoting “buildings of outstanding merit, which every effort should be made to preserve if possible.” Buildings “of special merit” are awarded Grade 2 status, meaning “efforts should be made to selectively preserve” them. People outside a coffee shop near the Kennedy Town Praya, in September 2023. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. According to the document, the Antiquities and Monuments Office will upload its heritage appraisal of the site for a one-month public consultation. ‘Check-in’ culture A quiet neighbourhood on the western end of Hong Kong Island, Kennedy Town has found fame on mainland Chinese social media platform Xiaohongshu in recent years. Among the “check-in spots” promoted by mainland Chinese tourists on the platform is a street sign fronting the sea that reads “New Praya, Kennedy Town.” Tourists can often be found lining up to take photos with the sign. A branch of Japanese coffee chain % Arabica, also beloved by Xiaohongshu users, stands just beside the famous sign. Proposed boardwalk for Kennedy Town’s New Praya waterfront. Photo: Harbourfront Commission. Authorities are also considering building a detached boardwalk along the New Praya waterfront to “enhance visitors’ experience” while preserving the view for social media users. The proposed development will require “small-scale reclamation,” according to development chief Bernadette Linn. Last year, Hong Kong’s legislature passed a bill making it easier for the government to reclaim more land in Victoria Harbour , doing away with a rule introduced in the 1990s requiring an “overriding public need” to be established before reclamation projects could go forward. A month after its passing, Linn warned about “soft resistance” against reclamation projects. Soon thereafter, the Society for the Protection of the Harbour, which for decades advocated to protect the harbour’s surviving waters, unanimously voted to disband .
body.zh: 香港正在考虑授予坚尼地城海滨一处风景如画的海滨景点历史等级地位，该景点在内地游客中人气飙升。 2023 年 8 月 15 日，人们在坚尼地城海旁附近的一家咖啡店外排队拍照。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。根据古物古迹办事处的备忘录，坚尼地城新海旁的海堤正在考虑评定为二级。古物咨询委员会将于下周四开会讨论此事。从街上看不到的海堤拥有一个多世纪的历史。香港的历史建筑分为三级，一级表示“具有杰出价值的建筑物，应尽力保存”。 “具有特殊价值”的建筑被授予二级地位，这意味着“应努力有选择地保护”它们。 2023 年 9 月，坚尼地城海旁附近一家咖啡店外的人们。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。根据该文件，古物古迹办事处将上传该遗址的文物鉴定结果，进行为期一个月的公众咨询。 “打卡”文化 坚尼地城是香港岛西端的一个安静街区，近年来在中国大陆社交媒体平台小红书上名声大噪。中国大陆游客在该平台上宣传的“打卡点”中有一个面向大海的路牌，上面写着“坚尼地城新海旁”。经常可以看到游客排队与这个标志拍照。日本咖啡连锁店%Arabica的一家分店就位于著名招牌旁边，也是小红书用户喜爱的品牌。坚尼地城新海傍海滨的拟议木板路。照片：海滨委员会。当局还在考虑沿着新海旁海滨修建一条独立的木板路，以“增强游客的体验”，同时保留社交媒体用户的视野。开发负责人伯纳黛特·林恩 (Bernadette Linn) 表示，拟议的开发项目将需要“小规模填海”。去年，香港立法机关通过了一项法案，使政府更容易在维多利亚港填海造地，废除了 20 世纪 90 年代引入的一项规定，即在填海项目进行之前必须先确定“压倒性的公众需求”。该法案通过一个月后，林恩对填海项目提出了“软阻力”警告。此后不久，几十年来一直主张保护港口幸存水域的港口保护协会一致投票解散。

reflection.en: This news from Hong Kong speaks to our human desire to preserve and honor places that hold beauty and history. The Psalmist, observing the natural world, declared, "How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all." The consideration for historic status for this seaside spot echoes a similar appreciation for enduring value, whether in human-made...
reflection.zh: 香港的这条新闻触及了我们保存和珍视具有历史和美感之地的愿望。诗篇的作者在观察自然界时宣告：“雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！万物都凭你的智慧造就。” 考虑将这个海滨景点列为历史建筑，与对持久价值的欣赏不谋而合，无论是人造建筑还是造物的宏伟设计。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

This expansion comes as part of an ambitious growth strategy, occurring amidst a broader trend of food and retail businesses closing down in the city. The brand, which has been in existence for...
summary.zh: 美国冰淇淋连锁店Dairy Queen（DQ）将于今年第四季度在香港开设四家新店，标志着其重返香港市场。此举是其雄心勃勃的扩张计划的一部分，发生在香港食品和零售业普遍关闭的背景下。这个拥有85年历史的品牌计划于11月在香港岛的铜锣湾一号购物中心开设其旗舰店。

body.en: American ice cream chain Dairy Queen will open four Hong Kong outlets in the fourth quarter of this year, as part of an ambitious expansion plan amid a wave of food and retail shop closures across the city. Dairy Queen, an 85-year-old brand, said on Friday that it would launch its flagship store at One Causeway Bay shopping centre on Hong Kong Island in November, followed by three other outlets in Kowloon, the New Territories and the outlying islands before the end of the year. “Following...
body.zh: 美国冰淇淋连锁店冰雪皇后将于今年第四季度在香港开设四家门店，作为其雄心勃勃的扩张计划的一部分，以应对香港各地食品和零售店关闭的浪潮。拥有 85 年历史的品牌冰雪皇后周五表示，将于 11 月在港岛铜锣湾一号购物中心开设旗舰店，年底前将在九龙、新界和离岛开设另外三家分店。 “下列的...

reflection.en: In a city experiencing a wave of business closures, Dairy Queen's ambitious plan to open four new outlets signals a bold entrepreneurial spirit. Committing one's ventures to God, as Proverbs 16:3 suggests, can provide a foundation for navigating economic uncertainty and pursuing growth with wisdom and integrity.
reflection.zh: 在经历了一波企业倒闭的城市中，DQ开设四家新店的宏伟计划预示着一种大胆的创业精神。正如箴言16:3所建议的，将事业托付于雅伟，可以为应对经济不确定性、并以智慧和正直追求增长奠定基础。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: HK Marathon 2027 hits record 78k runners in main races
title.zh: 香港马拉松2027吸引创纪录的7.8万名选手参加主要赛事

summary.en: The Standard Chartered Hong Kong Marathon is set to be its largest ever in 2027, with organizers planning a significant increase in race capacity and introducing new community events to broaden participation. The main race day will accommodate a record 78,000 participants, boosted by a 16% rise in the half marathon...
summary.zh: 渣打香港马拉松将于2027年迎来有史以来规模最大的一届，组织者计划大幅增加赛事容量并推出新的社区活动以扩大参与度。主要比赛日将容纳创纪录的78,000名参赛者，其中半程马拉松名额增加了16%。此外，还将举办全新的“5公里海滨跑”和扩大的青少年跑。

body.en: The Standard Chartered Hong Kong Marathon is gearing up for its largest edition ever in 2027, with organisers unveiling a major expansion in race capacity alongside a suite of new community-focused events designed to open long-distance running to a broader audience. Scheduled for January 17, the main race day will feature a record total quota of 78,000 participants, driven largely by a 16 percent increase in the half marathon allocation. This category alone will see its quota rise by 4,000 to a total of 29,000 runners. With the addition of a brand-new "5km Harbourfront Run" at Kai Tak Sports Park – open to all ages and abilities – and an expanded youth run for 10- to 15-year-olds on the preceding Saturday, the two-day festival is expected to welcome 84,000 participants, smashing all previous attendance records. Organisers attribute this significant growth to overwhelming public demand, following last year’s registration surge of 120,000 applicants. They also noted the half marathon's increasing popularity as a crucial stepping stone for runners eyeing the full marathon distance. To ensure the influx of runners does not lead to overcrowding, officials have implemented a refined start strategy, with Dennis Ng, Executive Director of the Hong Kong, China Association of Athletics Affiliates, saying that a staggered approach will keep the course safe and manageable. "This year, our approach is to keep the earliest race at 5.30am as the Challenge group. The number of participants for this group will be increased to around 2,500," he said. "As for the subsequent non-challenge races, we will increase them from three to four ... this is why there will be more participants. The government has allowed us to extend the section on Nathan Road all the way to Cherry Street in Mong Kok. "They have also extended the road closure time, allowing us to have an additional starting wave for the half-marathon start. As a result, the number of participants per wave has been reduced, but the total number has increased because we have added one extra wave." Beyond the competitive action, the Marathon Expo at Kai Tak Arena – which has drawn over 100,000 visitors annually for two years running – will once again serve as a bustling hub for participants and the public. The full marathon, half marathon, 10km race, and wheelchair event will all take place on January 17, with age-group categories remaining unchanged from previous years. Entries for athletes with disabilities will continue to be accepted. The public ballot registration – the main draw for general entrants – will open at 2pm on September 11. Registration dates for the new 5km Harbourfront Run and the youth run will be announced on a later date. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 渣打香港马拉松正为 2027 年有史以来最大规模的赛事做准备，组织者宣布将大幅扩大比赛容量，同时推出一系列以社区为中心的新活动，旨在向更广泛的观众开放长跑运动。定于 1 月 17 日举行的主赛日将有创纪录的 78,000 名参赛者总配额，这主要是由于半程马拉松的配额增加了 16%。仅此类别的参赛名额就将增加 4,000 名，达到 29,000 名参赛者。加上在启德体育公园新增的“5公里海滨跑”，向所有年龄层和水平的人士开放，以及在前一个星期六扩大为10至15岁青少年举办的青少年跑，为期两天的嘉年华预计将迎来84,000人次参加，打破以往的入场人数纪录。组织者将这一显着增长归因于公众的巨大需求，继去年报名人数激增 120,000 人之后。他们还指出，半程马拉松越来越受欢迎，成为关注全程马拉松的跑步者的重要垫脚石。为了确保跑步者的涌入不会导致过度拥挤，官员们实施了完善的出发策略，中国香港田径协会附属机构执行董事吴丹尼斯表示，交错的方式将保持赛道的安全和易于管理。 “今年，我们的做法是将最早的比赛保留在早上 5.30 作为挑战组。该组的参赛人数将增加到 2,500 人左右，”他说。 “至于后续的非挑战赛，我们会从三场增加到四场……这就是为什么会有更多的参赛者。政府允许我们把弥敦道的路段一直延伸到旺角樱桃街。”他们还延长了封路时间，让我们可以为半程马拉松的起跑多一波起跑。因此，每一波的参赛人数有所减少，但总人数有所增加，因为我们多了一波。”除了竞技赛事外，连续两年每年吸引超过10万人次参观的启德综艺馆马拉松博览，将再次成为参赛者和公众的热闹枢纽。全程马拉松、半程马拉松、10公里赛跑和轮椅项目均将于1月17日举行，年龄组别不变继续接受往年的残疾运动员报名。公众抽签活动将于 9 月 11 日下午 2 点开始。新 5 公里海滨跑和青少年跑的报名日期将在稍后公布。

reflection.en: The Hong Kong Marathon's expansion to 78,000 runners in 2027 speaks to a collective human drive for achievement and perseverance. The Apostle Paul reminds us in 1 Corinthians 9:24 that athletes train rigorously for a perishable crown, urging us to do the same for an eternal one. This dedication to pushing limits, whether on the road or in life's journey,...
reflection.zh: 香港马拉松将于2027年扩大至78,000名跑者参赛，这体现了人类对成就和毅力的集体追求。使徒保罗在哥林多前书9章24节提醒我们，运动员为必朽坏的冠冕刻苦训练，并鼓励我们为永恒的冠冕也如此行。这种挑战极限的奉献精神，无论是在赛道上还是在人生的旅途中，都与属灵成长所需的纪律相呼应。

verse.textEn: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one gets the prize? Run in such a way as to get the prize.
verse.textZh: 岂不知在场上赛跑的都跑，但得奖赏的只有一人？你们也当这样跑，好叫你们得着奖赏。

title.en: Singapore says China arrests 52 citizens in pyramid scheme clampdown
title.zh: 新加坡称中国在打击金字塔骗局中逮捕了52名公民

summary.en: China has arrested 52 Singaporeans suspected of involvement in pyramid schemes, Singapore said Friday, in what local media in the city-state said could be the largest detention of its citizens overseas to date. The arrests took place in China’s southern province of Guangxi during a law enforcement operation targeting...
summary.zh: 新加坡周五表示，中国已逮捕了52名涉嫌参与金字塔骗局的新加坡公民，这可能是迄今为止在海外被拘留的新加坡公民人数最多的一次。逮捕行动发生在中国广西省，是针对涉嫌金字塔骗局及相关犯罪的执法行动的一部分，新加坡外交部和警方在一份联合声明中说。

body.en: China has arrested 52 Singaporeans suspected of involvement in pyramid schemes, Singapore said Friday, in what local media in the city-state said could be the largest detention of its citizens overseas to date. Singapore. File photo: Tom Grundy/HKFP. The arrests took place in China’s southern province of Guangxi during a law enforcement operation targeting suspected pyramid schemes and related offences, Singapore’s foreign ministry and police said in a joint statement. It did not say when the arrests took place. “Investigations by the Chinese authorities are ongoing. The Singapore Police Force has contacted its Chinese counterparts to seek more information,” the statement added. Singaporean diplomats have visited the detained suspects to check on their well-being and provide consular assistance, it added. The statement urged Singaporeans “to exercise caution when invited to take part in schemes involving the recruitment of participants or the upfront payment of substantial sums of money, whether overseas or locally”. China has not confirmed the arrests. Contacted by AFP, Beijing’s foreign ministry said authorities handle criminal cases involving foreign nationals “in accordance with the law”. Great Hall of the People. Photo: Lukas Messmer/HKFP. Singapore has seen major cases involving Chinese nationals accused of running or facilitating cross-border criminal operations. In 2023, police arrested 10 Chinese nationals and Chinese-born foreigners in a sweeping anti-money laundering operation that ultimately involved some US$2.4 billion in seized or frozen assets, including luxury properties, vehicles, cash and cryptocurrency.
body.zh: 新加坡周五表示，中国逮捕了 52 名涉嫌参与传销的新加坡人，新加坡当地媒体称，这可能是迄今为止在海外最大规模的一次拘留新加坡公民事件。新加坡。资料照片：Tom Grundy/HKFP。新加坡外交部和警方在一份联合声明中表示，逮捕行动是在中国南部省份广西针对涉嫌传销和相关犯罪的执法行动中进行的。它没有透露逮捕发生的时间。声明补充说：“中国当局的调查正在进行中。新加坡警察部队已联系中国同行以寻求更多信息。”新加坡外交官已探望被拘留的嫌疑人，了解他们的健康状况并提供领事协助。声明敦促新加坡人“在受邀参加涉及招募参与者或预付大笔资金的计划时要谨慎行事，无论是在海外还是在本地”。中国尚未证实逮捕行动。北京外交部在接受法新社采访时表示，当局“依法”处理涉及外国人的刑事案件。人民大会堂。照片：Lukas Messmer/HKFP。新加坡发生了涉及中国公民被指控进行或协助跨境犯罪活动的重大案件。 2023 年，警方在一次大规模反洗钱行动中逮捕了 10 名中国公民和在中国出生的外国人，最终查获或冻结了约 24 亿美元的资产，包括豪华房产、车辆、现金和加密货币。

reflection.en: The news of 52 Singaporeans arrested in China for alleged pyramid schemes highlights the destructive allure of quick financial gain. The pursuit of wealth, when it becomes an idol, can lead individuals into dangerous schemes and severe consequences, as seen in this mass arrest. This situation serves as a somber reminder of the dangers of greed and the...
reflection.zh: 52名新加坡公民因涉嫌参与金字塔骗局在中国被捕的消息，凸显了快速获利的诱惑所带来的破坏性。当对财富的追求成为一种崇拜时，它可能将个人引入危险的骗局并导致严重的后果，正如这次大规模逮捕事件所示。 这一事件令人警醒地提醒我们贪婪的危险以及道德金融实践的重要性。它印证了圣经的警告：贪财是万恶之根，它会引人陷入网罗，导致毁灭和纠缠。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty in second national security case
title.zh: 香港民主派活动人士黄之锋承认在第二起国安案中认罪

summary.en: Joshua Wong, a prominent pro-democracy activist in Hong Kong, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to charges under the national security law, specifically conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against China. The charge carries a maximum penalty of life imprisonment.
summary.zh: 香港一位著名的民主派活动人士黄之锋周三承认触犯国安法，罪名是共谋寻求外国制裁中国，该罪名最高可判处无期徒刑。

body.en: Wong, 29, is accused of urging foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades and other hostile measures against China Joshua Wong , one of Hong Kong’s most prominent pro-democracy activists, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against Hong Kong and China, a national security charge that carries a maximum life sentence. Prosecutors have accused Wong, 29, of working with the exiled Hong Kong activist Nathan Law to urge foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades or other hostile measures against China. Continue reading...
body.zh: 29 岁的黄之锋被指控敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁和其他敌对措施。香港最著名的民主活动人士之一黄之锋周三承认密谋寻求外国对香港和中国实施制裁，这一国家安全指控最高可判处无期徒刑。检察官指控 29 岁的黄与流亡香港活动人士罗冠聪合作，敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁或其他敌对措施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Joshua Wong, a young activist known for his role in Hong Kong's democracy movement, has pleaded guilty to charges under the national security law. This situation brings to the fore the difficult tension between civic obedience and deeply held convictions. The apostles' unwavering stance, 'We must obey God rather than human beings,' offers a timeless...
reflection.zh: 香港一位以其在民主运动中角色而闻名的年轻活动人士黄之锋，已承认触犯国安法。这一局面凸显了公民服从与内心深处信念之间的艰难张力。使徒们坚定的立场——“顺从神，过于顺从人”——为这种良心冲突提供了永恒的视角。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Shein shares slide on fast-fashion retailer’s stock market debut
title.zh: Shein股票上市首日下跌，快时尚零售商估值缩水

summary.en: Shares of the fast-fashion brand Shein fell as much as 10% on their debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The company, founded in China and now headquartered in Singapore, was valued at just over $26 billion, a significant drop from its previous valuation of nearly $100 billion.
summary.zh: 快时尚品牌Shein在香港证券交易所上市首日股价下跌高达10%。这家中国创立、现总部设在新加坡的公司，估值略高于260亿美元，远低于其此前近1000亿美元的估值。

body.en: Hong Kong flotation at $26bn by firm once valued at $100bn follows failure to list in US and UK Shares in the fast-fashion brand Shein slumped by as much as 10% as the China-founded company made its long-anticipated trading debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The Singapore-headquartered company, once valued at almost $100bn (£74bn), went public on Tuesday pricing shares at HK$48.56, valuing the business at just over $26bn. Continue reading...
body.zh: 曾估值 1000 亿美元的公司在香港发行 260 亿美元，此前该公司未能在美国和英国上市。快时尚品牌 Shein 在香港证券交易所首次上市后，其股价下跌了 10%。这家总部位于新加坡的公司一度估值近 1000 亿美元（740 亿英镑），周二上市，股价为 48.56 港元，业务估值略高于 260 亿美元。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The dramatic drop in Shein's valuation on its Hong Kong stock market debut, from nearly $100 billion to just over $26 billion, serves as a potent reminder of the volatile nature of commerce. Proverbs 16:3 encourages us to commit our endeavors to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish our plans, a wisdom that transcends market highs and lows.
reflection.zh: Shein在香港股市上市首日估值从近1000亿美元暴跌至略高于260亿美元，这有力地提醒我们商业的波动性。箴言16:3鼓励我们将所做的事交托给雅伟，信靠祂必成就我们的计划，这智慧超越了市场的起伏。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Science & Nature Desk
title.zh: 自然科学

strap.en: Discoveries in nature, climate, health, and the wider cosmos.
strap.zh: 自然、气候、健康与宇宙万象的新发现。

title.en: A new type of LED light could bring significant efficiency gains
title.zh: 一种新型LED灯有望带来显著的能效提升

summary.en: Researchers at Lund University have developed a new type of light-emitting diode (LED) based on thin, branched nanowires. This innovation could lead to significantly higher efficiency and lower production costs compared to current LED technology. The breakthrough involves controlling the light generation within the...
summary.zh: 隆德大学的研究人员开发了一种基于细小、分支状纳米线的新型发光二极管（LED）。与当前LED技术相比，这项创新有望带来显著更高的效率和更低的生产成本。这项突破在于控制纳米线结构中产生光的位置，以最大限度地减少能量损失。

body.en: Researchers at Lund University have developed a new type of light-emitting diode based on thin, branched nanowires that could offer significantly higher efficiency and lower production costs than current technology. By controlling where in the structure the light is generated, the researchers have reduced the losses that would otherwise limit the amount of light that can be used. Their study is published in the journal Nano Research.
body.zh: 隆德大学的研究人员开发了一种基于细分支纳米线的新型发光二极管，与现有技术相比，它可以提供显着更高的效率和更低的生产成本。通过控制结构中产生光的位置，研究人员减少了损失，否则会限制可使用的光量。他们的研究发表在《纳米研究》杂志上。

reflection.en: The pursuit of innovation in areas like lighting efficiency reflects a human drive to improve the world around us. Colossians 3:23 reminds us that our work, whether in a lab or elsewhere, can be an act of devotion when done with diligence and excellence, honoring Yahweh through our craft. This dedication to improving technology, like the nanowire LEDs...
reflection.zh: 在照明效率等领域追求创新，反映了人类改善周围世界的内在驱动力。歌罗西书3:23提醒我们，我们的工作，无论是在实验室还是其他地方，当尽心竭力地去做时，都可以成为一种敬虔的行为，通过我们的技艺来荣耀雅伟。...

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: In ant nervous systems, gene expression may drive rescue behavior
title.zh: 在蚂蚁神经系统中，基因表达可能驱动救援行为

summary.en: A study by researchers from Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz and Tel Aviv University investigated why some ants help distressed nestmates while others do not. Their findings, published in the Journal of Experimental Biology, suggest that differences in gene activity within the nervous system, rather than physical...
summary.zh: 约翰内斯·古腾堡大学美因茨分校和特拉维夫大学的研究人员进行的一项研究，调查了为什么有些蚂蚁会帮助处于困境中的同巢蚂蚁，而有些则不会。他们的研究结果发表在《实验生物学杂志》上，表明神经系统中基因活动的差异，而不是体型或能量储备等身体特征，是关键因素。

body.en: Why do some ants help nestmates in distress while others don't? A research team from Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz (JGU) and Tel Aviv University addressed this question in a new study. The researchers examined worker ants of the species Cataglyphis niger, some of which had shown rescue behavior while others had not. The results, recently published in the Journal of Experimental Biology, suggest that the key difference lies not in body size, morphology or the animals' energy reserves, but in gene activity in the nervous system.
body.zh: 为什么有些蚂蚁会帮助陷入困境的同伴，而另一些却不会？来自美因茨约翰内斯古腾堡大学 (JGU) 和特拉维夫大学的研究小组在一项新研究中解决了这个问题。研究人员检查了 Cataglyphis niger 种工蚁，其中一些表现出了救援行为，而另一些则没有。最近发表在《实验生物学杂志》上的研究结果表明，关键的区别不在于体型、形态或动物的能量储备，而在于神经系统中的基因活动。

reflection.en: The intricate behaviors of ants, like helping nestmates, reveal the complex systems Yahweh has woven into creation. Observing these tiny creatures and the genetic underpinnings of their actions offers a glimpse into the Creator's wisdom. It reminds us that even in the smallest of lives, there are profound lessons to be learned about cooperation and instinct.
reflection.zh: 蚂蚁复杂的行为，例如帮助同巢蚂蚁，揭示了雅伟编织到创造物中的复杂系统。观察这些微小的生物及其行为的遗传基础，可以一窥造物主的智慧。它提醒我们，即使在最小的生命中，也有关于合作和本能的深刻教训。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
